verses.sloka: ते निवृत्ता महाकायाः श्रुत्वा ऽङ्गदवचस्तदा।नैष्ठिकीं बुद्धिमासाद्य सर्वे सङ्ग्रामकाङ्क्षिणः ।। ६.६७.१ ।।्रशक्त्या ।। ६.६७.१९ ।। ।।व चक्षुषा।समुदीरितवीर्याश्च समारोपितविक्रमाः।पर्यवस्थापिता वाक्यैरङ्गदेन वलीमुखाः ।। ६.६७.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: te nivṛttā mahākāyāḥ śrutvā 'ṅgadavacastadā।naiṣṭhikīṁ buddhimāsādya sarve saṅgrāmakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ।। 6.67.1 ।।्raśaktyā ।। 6.67.19 ।। ।।va cakṣuṣā।samudīritavīryāśca samāropitavikramāḥ।paryavasthāpitā vākyairaṅgadena valīmukhāḥ ।। 6.67.2 ।।

translations.english: Having heard Angada's words, the Vanaras of gigantic body firmly decided to wage war and returned back.
translations.hindi: पप्या §— Po पञ्च पष्ठितमः संगः —:°— € स तथोक्तस्तु निर्भव्श्य कुम्मकर्णों महोद्रप । अब्रवीद्राब्षसश्रेष्ठ आतरं रावणं तत;

verses.sloka: प्रयाताश्च गता हर्षं मरणे कृतनिश्चयाः।चक्रुः सुतुमुलं युद्धं वानरास्त्यक्तजीविताः ।। ६.६७.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: prayātāśca gatā harṣaṁ maraṇe kṛtaniścayāḥ।cakruḥ sutumulaṁ yuddhaṁ vānarāstyaktajīvitāḥ ।। 6.67.3 ।।

translations.english: The Vanara leaders, having been reminded of their valour in battle by Angada gladly returned with a resolve to stake their life and carried on the battle.

verses.sloka: अथ वृक्षान् महाकायाः सानूनि सुमहान्ति च।वानरास्तूर्णमुद्यम्य कुम्भकर्णमभिद्रुताः ।। ६.६७.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: atha vṛkṣān mahākāyāḥ sānūni sumahānti ca।vānarāstūrṇamudyamya kumbhakarṇamabhidrutāḥ ।। 6.67.4 ।।

translations.english: The Vanara leaders, having been reminded of their valour in battle by Angada gladly returned with a resolve to stake their life and carried on the battle.
translations.hindi: जो वीर होते हैं वे जलशून्य माइलो की तरह बृथा नहीं गरजते | मेंने जो गर्जन किआ है, सा तुम समर सें सुकरो अपनी गर्जेना के अनुप्तार काये करते हुए देखना

verses.sloka: स कुम्भकर्णः सङ्क्रुद्धो गदामुद्यम्य वीर्यवान्।अर्दयन् सुमहाकायः समन्ताद्व्यक्षिपद्रिपून् ।। ६.६७.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa kumbhakarṇaḥ saṅkruddho gadāmudyamya vīryavān।ardayan sumahākāyaḥ samantādvyakṣipadripūn ।। 6.67.5 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter the Vanaras of huge body wielding huge trees and mountain peaks quickly rushed towards Kumbhakarna.
translations.hindi: जो शूर होते हैं दे दूसरे को अपमानजनक बातों को सुनना कभी सहन नहीं कर सकते भर न वे अपनी प्रतिष्ठा हठी के भूखे होते हैं। किन्तु शूर लोग कोई भो दुष्कर कमं करने के पूवं प्रकट न कर उसको कर के दिखला देते हैँ

verses.sloka: शतानि सप्त चाष्टौ च सहस्राणि च वानराः।प्रकीर्णाः शेरते भूमौ कुम्भकर्णेन पोथिताः ।। ६.६७.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: śatāni sapta cāṣṭau ca sahasrāṇi ca vānarāḥ।prakīrṇāḥ śerate bhūmau kumbhakarṇena pothitāḥ ।। 6.67.6 ।।

translations.english: Valiant Kumbhakarna, a gigantic one, highly enraged lifted mace and crescent shaped arrow struck the enemies on all sides.
translations.hindi: हे महोदर ! कादर और अपने को पण्डित मानने बाले, किन्तु वास्तव में निर्बुद्वि राजा ही, तुम्हारो कही हुई जेसो बातें सुनना पसन्द करते हैं। अथवा तुम्हारा यह परासशे उन्हें अच्छा लग सकता हे

verses.sloka: षोडशाष्टौ च दश च विंशत्ऺित्रंशत्तथैव च।परिक्षिप्य च बाहुभ्यां खादन् विपरिधावति।भक्षयन् भृशसङ्क्रुद्धो गरुडः पन्नगानिव ।। ६.६७.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: ṣoḍaśāṣṭau ca daśa ca viṁśatऺitraṁśattathaiva ca।parikṣipya ca bāhubhyāṁ khādan viparidhāvati।bhakṣayan bhṛśasaṅkruddho garuḍaḥ pannagāniva ।। 6.67.7 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna held seven or eight or even hundred, thousand vanaras and threw them on the ground like serpents thrown by Garuda.
translations.hindi: आप जैसे चापलूस रएभीरु और राजा को हाँ में हाँ मिलाने वाल्ले लोगों ही ने तो बह सारा काम चौपट किआ है

verses.sloka: कृच्छ्रेण च समाश्वस्ताः सङ्गम्य च ततस्ततः।वृक्षाद्रिहस्ता हरयस्तस्थुः सङ्ग्राममूर्धनि ।। ६.६७.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: kṛcchreṇa ca samāśvastāḥ saṅgamya ca tatastataḥ।vṛkṣādrihastā harayastasthuḥ saṅgrāmamūrdhani ।। 6.67.8 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna became extremely angry, and caught hold of sixteen, eight, ten vanaras in the same way ninetynine and thirty and many more Vanaras and devoured them and went about like Garuda after having eaten the serpents.

verses.sloka: ततः पर्वतमुत्पाट्य द्विविदः प्लवगर्षभः।दुद्राव गिरिशृङ्गाभं विलम्ब इव तोयदः ।। ६.६७.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ parvatamutpāṭya dvividaḥ plavagarṣabhaḥ।dudrāva giriśṛṅgābhaṁ vilamba iva toyadaḥ ।। 6.67.9 ।।

translations.english: The Vanaras collected from here and there, having restored confidence in themselves with great difficulty, held trees and mountains and stood in the forefront of the battle.

verses.sloka: तं समुत्पत्य चिक्षेप कुम्भकर्णस्य वानरः।तमप्राप्तो महाकायं तस्य सैन्ये ऽपतत्तदा ।। ६.६७.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ samutpatya cikṣepa kumbhakarṇasya vānaraḥ।tamaprāpto mahākāyaṁ tasya sainye 'patattadā ।। 6.67.10 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Dwivida, a bull among the Vanaras lifted a mountain and went towards Kumbhakarna who resembled a threatening cloud.

verses.sloka: ममर्दाश्वान् गजांश्चापि रथांश्चैव नगोत्तमः।तानि चान्यानि रक्षांसि पुनश्चान्यद्गिरेः शिरेः ।। ६.६७.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: mamardāśvān gajāṁścāpi rathāṁścaiva nagottamaḥ।tāni cānyāni rakṣāṁsi punaścānyadgireḥ śireḥ ।। 6.67.11 ।।

translations.english: Vanara (Dwivida) going near Kumbhakarna struck him with the mountain. He missed the target and it fell on his army.
translations.hindi: हे कुम्मकर्ण ! निश्चय ही यह सहोदर राम से डरा हुआ है। हे तात ! हे युद्धविशारद ! इसी से इसको राम के साथ लड़ना पसन्द नहीं है

verses.sloka: तच्छैलशृङ्गाभिहतं हताश्वं हतसारथि।रक्षसां रुधिरक्लिन्नं बभूवायोधनं महत् ।। ६.६७.१२ ।।६.६७.१२९ ।।।।। ६.६७.१२३ ।।णो वीरो निर्दहन्निव चक्षुषा।रथिनो वानरेन्द्राणां शरैः कालान्तकोपमैः।शिरांसि नदतां जह्रुः सहसा भीमनिस्वनाः ।। ६.६७.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tacchailaśṛṅgābhihataṁ hatāśvaṁ hatasārathi।rakṣasāṁ rudhiraklinnaṁ babhūvāyodhanaṁ mahat ।। 6.67.12 ।।6.67.129 ।।।।। 6.67.123 ।।ṇo vīro nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā।rathino vānarendrāṇāṁ śaraiḥ kālāntakopamaiḥ।śirāṁsi nadatāṁ jahruḥ sahasā bhīmanisvanāḥ ।। 6.67.13 ।।

translations.english: The huge mountain peak crushed the horses, elephants and chariots and Rakshasa charioteers also.
translations.hindi: हे कुम्भक ! सेरे हितखाधन में और बल-विक्रम में तुम्हारे समान मेरा शुभचिन्तक दूसरा कोई नहीं है । खो तुम अब शत्रू को मारने ओर विजयश्री प्राप्त करने, के लिए यात्रा करो

verses.sloka: वानराश्च महात्मानः समुत्पाट्य महाद्रुमान्।रथानश्वान् गजानुष्ट्रान् राक्षसानभ्यसूदयन् ।। ६.६७.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: vānarāśca mahātmānaḥ samutpāṭya mahādrumān।rathānaśvān gajānuṣṭrān rākṣasānabhyasūdayan ।। 6.67.14 ।।

translations.english: The battlefield on which the Rakshasas and horses were crushed, charioteers were killed by the speed of the mountain remained wet with blood.
translations.hindi: तस्माचु भयनाशा थे भवान्‌ सम्मोधितो मया । अयं हि काल; सुद्दृदां राबसानामरिन्दम

verses.sloka: हनुमान् शैलशृङ्गाणि वृक्षांश्च विविधान् बहून्।ववर्ष कुम्भकर्णस्य शिरस्यम्बरमास्थितः ।। ६.६७.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: hanumān śailaśṛṅgāṇi vṛkṣāṁśca vividhān bahūn।vavarṣa kumbhakarṇasya śirasyambaramāsthitaḥ ।। 6.67.15 ।।

translations.english: The Rakshasa charioteers severed the roaring Vanara leaders forcibly with their arrows emitting frightening sounds. They were like the Lord of Death at universal dissolution.

verses.sloka: तानि पर्वतशृङ्गाणि शूलेन स बिभेद ह।बभञ्ज वृक्षवर्षं च कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः ।। ६.६७.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāni parvataśṛṅgāṇi śūlena sa bibheda ha।babhañja vṛkṣavarṣaṁ ca kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ ।। 6.67.16 ।।

translations.english: Great monkeys, uprooting huge trees, began to destroy chariots, horses, camels, and Rakshasas.
translations.hindi: तुम्हारी शक्ल देखते ही बानर भाग खड़े होंगे और रास _ लक्ष्मण का कलेजा भी दहल जायगा अथात फट जायगा

verses.sloka: ततो हरीणां तदनीकमुग्रं दुद्राव शूलं निशितं प्रगृह्य।तस्थौ ततो ऽस्यापततः पुरस्तान्महीधराग्रं हनुमान् प्रगृह्य ।। ६.६७.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato harīṇāṁ tadanīkamugraṁ dudrāva śūlaṁ niśitaṁ pragṛhya।tasthau tato 'syāpatataḥ purastānmahīdharāgraṁ hanumān pragṛhya ।। 6.67.17 ।।

translations.english: Stationed in the sky Hanuman rained mountain peaks, rocks, and huge trees of several kinds on the head of Kumbhakarna.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार राक्षसश्रेष्ठ रावण ने कुम्भकणै से कह कर, अपना पुनर्जन्म हुआ सा माना; अर्थात्‌ उसकी अपने विज्ञय का अब पूर्ण विश्वास हो गया

verses.sloka: स कुम्भकर्णं कुपितो जघान वेगेन शैलोत्तमभीमकायम्।स चुक्षुभे तेन तदा ऽभिभूतो मेदार्द्रगात्रो रुधिरावसिक्तः ।। ६.६७.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa kumbhakarṇaṁ kupito jaghāna vegena śailottamabhīmakāyam।sa cukṣubhe tena tadā 'bhibhūto medārdragātro rudhirāvasiktaḥ ।। 6.67.18 ।।

translations.english: Mighty Kumbhakarna split off the rocks, mountain peaks and the trees breaking them.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि रावण, कुम्भकर्ण के बल पराक्रम को भली भरति जानता था । सो वह मारे हर्षे के इस प्रकार खिल उठा जिस प्रकार निम ल चन्द्रमा खिल उठता है

verses.sloka: स शूलमाविध्य तडित्प्रकाशं गिरिं यथा प्रज्वलिताग्रशृङ्गम्।बाह्वन्तरे मारुतिमाजघान गुहो ऽचलं क्रौञ्चमिवोग्रशक्त्या ।। ६.६७.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa śūlamāvidhya taḍitprakāśaṁ giriṁ yathā prajvalitāgraśṛṅgam।bāhvantare mārutimājaghāna guho 'calaṁ krauñcamivograśaktyā ।। 6.67.19 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Kumbhakarna holding a sharp pike rushed towards Hanuman who uprooted a mountain peak and obstructed him placing it before him.
translations.hindi: महाबली कुम्भकर्ण राजा के ऐसे वचन सुन, हर्षित हो राजाज्ञा से युद्धयात्रा करने को तैयार हो गया

verses.sloka: स शूलनिर्भिन्नमहाभूजान्तरः प्रविह्वलः शोणितमुद्वमन् मुखात्।ननाद भीमं हनुमान् महाहवे युगान्तमेघस्तनितस्वनोपमम् ।। ६.६७.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: sa śūlanirbhinnamahābhūjāntaraḥ pravihvalaḥ śoṇitamudvaman mukhāt।nanāda bhīmaṁ hanumān mahāhave yugāntameghastanitasvanopamam ।। 6.67.20 ।।

translations.english: Enraged Hanuman struck Kumbhakarna endowed with a rock like frightening body. Overpowered by that blow Kumbhakarna was upset and bespattered with fat and got bathed in blood.

verses.sloka: ततो विनेदुः सहसा प्रहृष्टा रक्षोगणास्तं व्यथितं समीक्ष्य।प्लवङ्गमास्तु व्यथिता भयार्ताः प्रदुद्रुवुः संयति कुम्भकर्णात् ।। ६.६७.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato vineduḥ sahasā prahṛṣṭā rakṣogaṇāstaṁ vyathitaṁ samīkṣya।plavaṅgamāstu vyathitā bhayārtāḥ pradudruvuḥ saṁyati kumbhakarṇāt ।। 6.67.21 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna ,who was like a mountain blazing like fire, pierced at Maruti's chest with his pike shining like lightning just as Guha struck at Krauncha mountain.

verses.sloka: ततस्तु नीलो बलवान् पर्यवस्थापयन् बलम्।प्रविचिक्षेप शैलाग्रं कुम्भकर्णाय धीमते ।। ६.६७.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatastu nīlo balavān paryavasthāpayan balam।pravicikṣepa śailāgraṁ kumbhakarṇāya dhīmate ।। 6.67.22 ।।

translations.english: The great son of windgod, pierced with pike in the chest, ejected blood from his mouth, and roared in a frightening manner which was like thunder rumbling at the time of dissolution of the universe.
translations.hindi: उसके ऊपर लाल फूलों की मालाएँ पड़ी हुई थीं और वह बड़ा तेजयुक्त ( चमचमाता हुआ ) था। क्योंकि उसमें से आप ही आप आग की चिनगारियाँ निकल रही थीं । शत्रु के रक्त से सना हुआ होने के कारण बह रक्त ही जैसे रंग का हो रहा था । उस पेने शूल को लले

verses.sloka: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य मुष्टिना ऽभिजघान ह।मुष्टिप्रहाराभिहतं तच्छैलाग्रं व्यशीर्यत ।। ६.६७.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamāpatantaṁ samprekṣya muṣṭinā 'bhijaghāna ha।muṣṭiprahārābhihataṁ tacchailāgraṁ vyaśīryata ।। 6.67.23 ।।

translations.english: Rakshasa's army collected together rejoiced to see Hanuman agonized. Vanaras were frightened and fled in fear of Kumbhakarna.

verses.sloka: सविस्फुलिङ्गं सज्वालं निपपात महीतले।ऋषभः शरभो नीलो गवाक्षो गन्धमादनः ।। ६.६७.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: savisphuliṅgaṁ sajvālaṁ nipapāta mahītale।ṛṣabhaḥ śarabho nīlo gavākṣo gandhamādanaḥ ।। 6.67.24 ।।

translations.english: The mighty and wise Neela flung a peak of a mountain on Kumbhakarna and restored the confidence of the army.
translations.hindi: में आज क्रद्ध हो उन .चंचल बानरों.को खा डालूगा। कम्भकण के ये बचन सुन राबण ने उससे क.हा-—

verses.sloka: पञ्च वानरशार्दूलाः कुम्भकर्णमुपाद्रवन् ।। ६.६७.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: pañca vānaraśārdūlāḥ kumbhakarṇamupādravan ।। 6.67.25 ।।

translations.english: (Kumbhakarna) observing the mountain peak coming towards him pierced it with his fist. Struck by the fist, the peak broke and sparks of fire came out shining brightly and fell on the ground.
translations.hindi: महाधाम--मद्दातेः। ( गो० ) महात्मान:-- महाबुद्धयः । (गो०) ३सुब्यवसायिनः-ददनिश्चयाः । ( गो० ६३० युद्धकाए डे देखो, कहनों, अपने साथ सेना को और हाथ में शूल ले कर जाओ । क्योंकि बानर बड़े बुद्धिमान, सा ओर दढ निश्चय बाले ई अर्थात वे जो बिचार लेते है, उसे पूरा किए बिना नहीं रहते

verses.sloka: शैलैर्वृक्षैस्तलैः पादैर्मुष्टिभिश्च महाबलाः।कुम्भकर्णं महाकायं सर्वतो ऽभिप्रदुद्रुवुः ।। ६.६७.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: śailairvṛkṣaistalaiḥ pādairmuṣṭibhiśca mahābalāḥ।kumbhakarṇaṁ mahākāyaṁ sarvato 'bhipradudruvuḥ ।। 6.67.26 ।।

translations.english: Rshaba, Sarabha, Neela, Gavaksha and Gandhamadana, these five tigers among Vanaras attacked Kumbhakarna.
translations.hindi: कहीं ऐसा न हो कि, तुमको अकेला पा और सद्मरत देख, वे तुमको दाँतों से काट काट कर नष्ट कर डाले । अतः तुम परम दुर्धष सेना को साथ लेकर जाओ

verses.sloka: स्पर्शानिव प्रहारांस्तान् वेदयानो न विव्यथे।ऋषभं तु महावेगं बाहुभ्यां परिषस्वजे ।। ६.६७.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sparśāniva prahārāṁstān vedayāno na vivyathe।ṛṣabhaṁ tu mahāvegaṁ bāhubhyāṁ pariṣasvaje ।। 6.67.27 ।।

translations.english: Those Vanaras of exceptional strength attacked gigantic Kumbhakarna on all sides by rocks, trees and by their fists, hands and feet also.

verses.sloka: कुम्भकर्णभुजाभ्यां तु पीडितो वानरर्षभः।निपपातर्षभो भीमः प्रमुखाद्वान्तशोणितः ।। ६.६७.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: kumbhakarṇabhujābhyāṁ tu pīḍito vānararṣabhaḥ।nipapātarṣabho bhīmaḥ pramukhādvāntaśoṇitaḥ ।। 6.67.28 ।।

translations.english: Their attacks were like soft touches to Kumbhakarna, and no pain was experienced by him, and he encircled Rshaba by the shoulders with great impetuosity.
translations.hindi: श्रोणीसत्रेण मद्दता मेचकेन व्यराजत । अमृतोतपादने नद्धो जङ्ग नेव मन्दरः ॥२& ॥ उसको कमर में करघनी का काला डोरा ऐसा ज्ञात पड़ता था, मानों समुद्रभन्धन के लिए उद्यव धासुक्ी से लिपटा हुआ मन्दराचल पर्वत ही

verses.sloka: मुष्टिना शरभं हत्वा जानुना नीलमाहवे।आजघान गवाक्षं तु तलेनेन्द्ररिपुस्तदा ।। ६.६७.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: muṣṭinā śarabhaṁ hatvā jānunā nīlamāhave।ājaghāna gavākṣaṁ tu talenendraripustadā ।। 6.67.29 ।।

translations.english: Rshaba, the bull among Vanaras, of frightful appearance pressed by Kumbhakarna's shoulders, started bleeding from his teeth and fell down.
translations.hindi: उसके साथ बहुत से पैदल सै.नक भी हो लिये थे । वे बड़े जोर से गरजने वाले महाबलवान भयङ्कर एव भई नेत्र वाले राक्षस हाथों में शाख्न लिये हुए थे

verses.sloka: पादेनाभ्यहनत् क्रुद्धस्तरसा गन्धमादनम्।दत्तप्रहारव्यथिता मुमुहुः शोणितोक्षिताः ।। ६.६७.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: pādenābhyahanat kruddhastarasā gandhamādanam।dattaprahāravyathitā mumuhuḥ śoṇitokṣitāḥ ।। 6.67.30 ।।

translations.english: Angry Kumbhakarna (enemy of Indra) hit Sarabha with his fist, Neela with his knees hurt Gavaksha and slapped him with his palms. Gandhamadana was kicked with force.
translations.hindi: कार्नो में उसके सुन्दर कुण्ड पहिनाए । सोने के बाजूबंदों और गले के आशूषणों से भूपित बड़े बड़े कानों बाला कुन्भकणे हवन किए हुए अझि की तरह देख पड़ने लगा

verses.sloka: निपेतुस्ते तु मेदिन्यां निकृत्ता इव किंशुकाः।तेषु वानरमुख्येषु पतितेषु महात्मसु।वानराणां सहस्राणि कुम्भकर्णं प्रदुद्रुवुः ।। ६.६७.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: nipetuste tu medinyāṁ nikṛttā iva kiṁśukāḥ।teṣu vānaramukhyeṣu patiteṣu mahātmasu।vānarāṇāṁ sahasrāṇi kumbhakarṇaṁ pradudruvuḥ ।। 6.67.31 ।।

translations.english: Angry Kumbhakarna (enemy of Indra) hit Sarabha with his fist, Neela with his knees hurt Gavaksha and slapped him with his palms. Gandhamadana was kicked with force.

verses.sloka: तं शैलमिव शैलाभाः सर्वे ते प्लवगर्षभाः।समारुह्य समुत्पत्य ददंशुश्च महाबलाः ।। ६.६७.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ śailamiva śailābhāḥ sarve te plavagarṣabhāḥ।samāruhya samutpatya dadaṁśuśca mahābalāḥ ।। 6.67.32 ।।

translations.english: Hurt by the blows of Kumbhakarna, their eyes bathed in blood, the Vanaras fainted and fell on the ground like cut down Kimsuka trees.

verses.sloka: तं नखैर्दशनैश्चापि मुष्टिभिर्जानुभिस्तथा।कुम्भकर्णं महाकायं ते जघ्नुः प्लवगर्षभाः ।। ६.६७.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ nakhairdaśanaiścāpi muṣṭibhirjānubhistathā।kumbhakarṇaṁ mahākāyaṁ te jaghnuḥ plavagarṣabhāḥ ।। 6.67.33 ।।

translations.english: Being great leaders and the important among them fallen, the Vanaras went in thousands towards Kumbhakarna.
translations.hindi: डे आयो के प्रह गी कभी न टूटने बाला तथा बड़े बडे आथुधों के प्रहार से भी कम नप हवा तक न जा सके-ऐपे कवच को कुस्मकण ने रण किया । वह कबच अपनी कान्ति से बिजली की तरह 2 था। उस कवच को पहिन कुम्भकण ऐेपा जान पड़ता > ग माये बादलों के रंग से रंगा हिमालय पेत था, मानों सन्ध्यासमय के बादली के र ८१ । न जन्नत ना ६३२ ण्डे सबोमरशनद्वाङ्गः शूलपाणिः स रासः । तरिविक्रमकृतोत्साद्रो नारायण इवावभो

verses.sloka: स वानरसहस्रैस्तैराचितः पर्वतोपमः।रराज राक्षसव्याघ्रो गिरिरात्मरुहैरिव ।। ६.६७.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa vānarasahasraistairācitaḥ parvatopamaḥ।rarāja rākṣasavyāghro girirātmaruhairiva ।। 6.67.34 ।।

translations.english: The bulls among Vanaras themselves looking like mountains endowed with great strength climbed up Kumbhakarna and bit him.

verses.sloka: बाहुभ्यां वानरान् सर्वान् प्रगृह्य सुमहाबलः।भक्षयामास सङ्क्रुद्धो गरुडः पन्नगानिव ।। ६.६७.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: bāhubhyāṁ vānarān sarvān pragṛhya sumahābalaḥ।bhakṣayāmāsa saṅkruddho garuḍaḥ pannagāniva ।। 6.67.35 ।।

translations.english: The bulls among Vanaras hurt Kumbhakarna, endowed with strong shoulders, by scratching with nails, biting with teeth and hitting him with arms and fists.

verses.sloka: प्रक्षिप्ताः कुम्भकर्णेन वक्त्रे पातालसन्निभे।नासापुटाभ्यां निर्जग्मुः कर्णाभ्यां चैव वानराः ।। ६.६७.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: prakṣiptāḥ kumbhakarṇena vaktre pātālasannibhe।nāsāpuṭābhyāṁ nirjagmuḥ karṇābhyāṁ caiva vānarāḥ ।। 6.67.36 ।।

translations.english: The tiger among Rakshasas covered with thousands of Rakshasas was resembling a mountain with trees grown on itself.
translations.hindi: रथियों में श्रेष्ठ रथी कुम्भ कर्ण के पीछे पीछे शङ्ख, दुन्दभी बजाती हुई तथा श्रेष्ठ आयुर्धों को लिए हुए सेना गई । बड़े बड़े न्न थ प्रो रे टु राक्षस हाथियों, घोड़ों ओर मेघ की तरह गड्गडाहट कर के चलने वाले रथों में बैठ कर, उनके पीछे हो लिये

verses.sloka: भक्षयन् भृशसङ्क्रुद्धो हरीन् पर्वतसन्निभः।बभञ्ज वानरान् सर्वान् सङ्क्रुद्धो राक्षसोत्तमः ।। ६.६७.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: bhakṣayan bhṛśasaṅkruddho harīn parvatasannibhaḥ।babhañja vānarān sarvān saṅkruddho rākṣasottamaḥ ।। 6.67.37 ।।

translations.english: Holding the Vanaras, the mighty Kumbhakarna started devouring all Vanaras just as Garuda does with serpents.
translations.hindi: बहुत से राक्षस सर्पो', उँटों, खबरों, घोड़ों, सिंहों, हाथियों मृगों, हसादि पक्तियों पर सवार हो, उस भयङ्कर एव महाबलो कुस्भकण के पीछे हो लिये

verses.sloka: मांसशोणितसङ्क्लेदां भूमिं कुर्वन् स राक्षसः।चचार हरिसैन्येषु कालाग्निरिव मूर्च्छितः ।। ६.६७.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: māṁsaśoṇitasaṅkledāṁ bhūmiṁ kurvan sa rākṣasaḥ।cacāra harisainyeṣu kālāgniriva mūrcchitaḥ ।। 6.67.38 ।।

translations.english: As Kumbhakarna thrust Vanaras into his mouth, the Vanaras came out through his nostrils and also through his ears.
translations.hindi: रक्ताक्षाः सुमहाकाया नीलाञ्जनवयोपमा; । शूलानुद्यम्य खङ्गांश्व निशिताश्च परश्वथान्‌ उन बड़े डीलडोल के राबासो के नेत्र लाल लाल थे और वे सब काजल के ढेर कें समान जान पड़ते थे । वे शूल, तलवार, परश्वध, उठाए हुए जा रहे थे ॥ रैन ॥ भिन्दिपार्लाशच परिघान्‌ गदाश्च शुसलाचि च । तासस्कन्धांश्च विपुलान्‌ क्षेपनीयान्‌ दुरासदाम्‌

verses.sloka: वज्रहस्तो यथा शक्रः पाशहस्त इवान्तकः।शूलहस्तो बभौ सङ्ख्ये कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः ।। ६.६७.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: vajrahasto yathā śakraḥ pāśahasta ivāntakaḥ।śūlahasto babhau saṅkhye kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ ।। 6.67.39 ।।

translations.english: The foremost of the Rakshasas, who resembled a mountain became enraged and mutilated the Vanaras.

verses.sloka: यथा शुष्काण्यरण्यानि ग्रीष्मे दहति पावकः।तथा वानरसैन्यानि कुम्भकर्णो विनिर्दहत् ।। ६.६७.४० ।।
verses.transliteration: yathā śuṣkāṇyaraṇyāni grīṣme dahati pāvakaḥ।tathā vānarasainyāni kumbhakarṇo vinirdahat ।। 6.67.40 ।।

translations.english: That terrible Rakshasa swooning and wetting the ground with flesh and blood ranged through the army of Vanaras like fire at the time of dissolution of the universe.

verses.sloka: ततस्ते वध्यमानास्तु हतयूथा विनायकाः ।।
verses.transliteration: tataste vadhyamānāstu hatayūthā vināyakāḥ ।।

translations.english: Holding pike in hand, mighty Kumbhakarna was shining in the battlefield like Indra holding thunderbolt, and like Lord of Death holding the noose.
translations.hindi: समस्त अंगों भें आभूषण धारण किए हए हाथ में शूल लिये हुए वह राक्षस वैसा ही देख पड़ता था जैसे कि, तीन पग प्रथिवी नापने के समय नारायण देख पड़े थे

verses.sloka: वानरा भयसंविग्ना विनेदुर्विस्वरं भृशम् ।। ६.६७.४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: vānarā bhayasaṁvignā vinedurvisvaraṁ bhṛśam ।। 6.67.41 ।।

translations.english: Just as fire god consumes dried forest in summer, Kumbhakarna was consuming the Vanara army.

verses.sloka: अनेकशो वध्यमानाः कुम्भकर्णेन वानराः।राघवं शरणं जग्मुर्व्यथिताः खिन्नचेतसः ।। ६.६७.४२ ।।
verses.transliteration: anekaśo vadhyamānāḥ kumbhakarṇena vānarāḥ।rāghavaṁ śaraṇaṁ jagmurvyathitāḥ khinnacetasaḥ ।। 6.67.42 ।।

translations.english: Then with the army killed, the Vanaras moved without any leader making unnatural sounds out of fear and anger.
translations.hindi: उस समय उसके शरीर की चौडाइ सौ धबुष, ऊँचाई छः सौ धनुष थी। उसकी भयङ्कर आँ खे' छकड़े के पहिये के समान थीं । वह एक बड़े ऊँचे पत्र त के समान जान पड़ता था

verses.sloka: प्रभग्नान् वानरान् दृष्ट्वा वज्रहस्तसुतात्मजः।अभ्यधावत वेगेन कुम्भकर्णं महाहवे ।। ६.६७.४३ ।।
verses.transliteration: prabhagnān vānarān dṛṣṭvā vajrahastasutātmajaḥ।abhyadhāvata vegena kumbhakarṇaṁ mahāhave ।। 6.67.43 ।।

translations.english: Destroyed by Kumbhakarna in many ways, the Vanaras were heartbroken and sought the refuge of Raghava.
translations.hindi: साथ चलने वाले सैनिकों के पास जो, जले हुए पबत की तरह और विशाल मुख बाला कुम्भकर्ण, हँस कर कहने लगा

verses.sloka: शैलशृङ्गं महद्गृह्य विनदंश्च मुहुर्मुहुः।त्रासयन् राक्षसान् सर्वान् कुम्भकर्णपदानुगान् ।। ६.६७.४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: śailaśṛṅgaṁ mahadgṛhya vinadaṁśca muhurmuhuḥ।trāsayan rākṣasān sarvān kumbhakarṇapadānugān ।। 6.67.44 ।।

translations.english: The son of Vali who sprung from Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt seeing the Vanaras routed, rushed towards Kumbhakarna to assault.
translations.hindi: क प या टर, १ सल्िपत्य - स्वानुगमनायोयुक्तानां राक्षसानां समीप गता । ( गो० ) आज मैं कुपित हो वानरी सेनाओं और इनके यूथपतियों को वैसे ही भस्म कर डालू गा, जैसे आग पतंगों को भस्म कर देती है

verses.sloka: चिक्षेप शैलशिखरं कुम्भकर्णस्य मूर्धनि।स तेनाभिहतो ऽत्यर्थं गिरिशृङ्गेण मूर्धनि ।। ६.६७.४५ ।।
verses.transliteration: cikṣepa śailaśikharaṁ kumbhakarṇasya mūrdhani।sa tenābhihato 'tyarthaṁ giriśṛṅgeṇa mūrdhani ।। 6.67.45 ।।

translations.english: Angada taking a huge peak of a mountain roaring again and again following Kumbhakarna frightening the Rakshasas flung the mountain top on the forehead of Kumbhakarna and crushed him.
translations.hindi: अथवा दे बलवासी वानर अपने मन से तो मेरा कुछ नहीं . बिगाडते । बल्कि वे तो हम जैसे लोगों के नगरों ओर फुलवा- ` ड्यो की एक प्रकार की शोभा हैं

verses.sloka: कुम्भकर्णः प्रजज्वाल कोपेन महता तदा।सो ऽभ्यधावत वेगेन वालिपुत्रममर्षणः ।। ६.६७.४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: kumbhakarṇaḥ prajajvāla kopena mahatā tadā।so 'bhyadhāvata vegena vāliputramamarṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.67.46 ।।

translations.english: Hit on the forehead by Angada, Kumbhakarna, burning with fury rushed. The intolerant Rakshasa then rushed to Vali's son with force.
translations.hindi: हमारी पुरी छो घेरने वाले तो असल में राम लक्ष्मण हें उनके मारे जाने से अन्य सब सरे समान ही हँ--अतः मैं बुद में उन्हीं दोनों को सागा

verses.sloka: कुम्भकर्णो महानादस्त्रासयन् सर्ववानरान्।शूलं ससर्ज वै रोषादङ्गदे स महावलः ।। ६.६७.४७ ।।
verses.transliteration: kumbhakarṇo mahānādastrāsayan sarvavānarān।śūlaṁ sasarja vai roṣādaṅgade sa mahāvalaḥ ।। 6.67.47 ।।

translations.english: Hit on the forehead by Angada, Kumbhakarna, burning with fury rushed. The intolerant Rakshasa then rushed to Vali's son with force.
translations.hindi: जब कुम्भकर्णं ने उन राकसों से इस प्रकार कहा, तब वे राक्षस मानों समुद्र को छुब्ध करते हुए, बढ़े जोर से नाद करने लगे

verses.sloka: तमापतन्तं बुद्ध्वा तु युद्धमार्गविशारदः।लाघवान्मोचयामास बलवान् वानरर्षभः ।। ६.६७.४८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamāpatantaṁ buddhvā tu yuddhamārgaviśāradaḥ।lāghavānmocayāmāsa balavān vānararṣabhaḥ ।। 6.67.48 ।।

translations.english: Mighty Kumbhakarna agitated, making loud noise and frightening all the Vanaras hurled his pike on Angada.
translations.hindi: । € 0) श्री है तस्य निष्पततस्तूण कुम्भकण स्य धीमतः । ` बभवुधोंररूपाणि निमित्तानि सपन्तत;

verses.sloka: उत्पत्य चैनं सहसा तलेनोरस्यताडयत्।स तेनाभिहतः कोपात् प्रमुमोहाचलोपमः ।। ६.६७.४९ ।।
verses.transliteration: utpatya cainaṁ sahasā talenorasyatāḍayat।sa tenābhihataḥ kopāt pramumohācalopamaḥ ।। 6.67.49 ।।

translations.english: Angada who was knowledgeable of warfare, endowed with prowess, a bull among Vanaras, stopped the pike approaching him with agility and escaped.

verses.sloka: स लब्धसञ्ज्ञो बलवान् मुष्टिमावर्त्त्य राक्षसः।अपहासेन चिक्षेप विसञ्ज्ञः स पपात ह ।। ६.६७.५० ।।
verses.transliteration: sa labdhasañjño balavān muṣṭimāvarttya rākṣasaḥ।apahāsena cikṣepa visañjñaḥ sa papāta ha ।। 6.67.50 ।।

translations.english: Jumping up that way, Angada slapped him with his palm on the chest in anger. By that the mountain like Kumbhakarna became unconscious.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् प्लवगशार्दूले विसञ्ज्ञे पतिते भुवि।तच्छूलं समुपादाय सुग्रीवमभिदुद्रुवे ।। ६.६७.५१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmin plavagaśārdūle visañjñe patite bhuvi।tacchūlaṁ samupādāya sugrīvamabhidudruve ।। 6.67.51 ।।

translations.english: The mighty Rakshasa regained his consciousness and, doubling his fist hit Angada with the back of his hand and Angada fell, lost senses.
translations.hindi: मार्ग में जाते हुए कुस्भकण के शूल पर एक गीघ आ गिरा। कुम्भकण का वास नेत्र और वास सुजा फड़कने लगी

verses.sloka: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम्।उत्पपात तदा वीरः सुग्रीवो वानराधिपः ।। ६.६७.५२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamāpatantaṁ samprekṣya kumbhakarṇaṁ mahābalam।utpapāta tadā vīraḥ sugrīvo vānarādhipaḥ ।। 6.67.52 ।।

translations.english: When the tiger among the monkeys fell unconscious on ground, Kumbhakarna rushed towards Sugriva taking out the pike.
translations.hindi: निपपात तदा चोन्का ज्यलन्ती भीम निःस्वना । आदित्यो विष्प्रभश्चासीन्न प्रवाति सुखो$निल!॥४ १) भयङ्कर शब्द के साथ दहकती हुई उल्का अकाश से कम्भकण के सामने आ गिरी । उस समय सूर्य की चमक लुप्त हो गई और सुखदाई पवन का चलना भो बंद हो गया

verses.sloka: पर्वताग्रं समुत्क्षिप्य समाविध्य महाकपिः।अभिदुद्राव वेगेन कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् ।। ६.६७.५३ ।।
verses.transliteration: parvatāgraṁ samutkṣipya samāvidhya mahākapiḥ।abhidudrāva vegena kumbhakarṇaṁ mahābalam ।। 6.67.53 ।।

translations.english: Valiant Sugriva, seeing the mighty Kumbhakarna coming towards him jumped (in excitement).

verses.sloka: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य कुम्भकर्णः प्लवङ्गमम्।तस्थौ विकृतसर्वाङ्गो वानरेन्द्रसमुन्मुखः ।। ६.६७.५४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamāpatantaṁ samprekṣya kumbhakarṇaḥ plavaṅgamam।tasthau vikṛtasarvāṅgo vānarendrasamunmukhaḥ ।। 6.67.54 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva, of great prowess lifting a mountain peak, whirled it round and round and darted towards Kumbhakarna swiftly.

verses.sloka: कपिशोणितदिग्धाङ्गं भक्षयन्तं प्लवङ्गमान्।कुम्भकर्णं स्थितं दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.६७.५५ ।।
verses.transliteration: kapiśoṇitadigdhāṅgaṁ bhakṣayantaṁ plavaṅgamān।kumbhakarṇaṁ sthitaṁ dṛṣṭvā sugrīvo vākyamabravīt ।। 6.67.55 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna, looking at the monkey Lord advancing towards him, stood in front of all limbs braced.
translations.hindi: पर्वत के समान लंबे कुम्भकर्ण को देख, वे वानर चारों ओर वैसे ही भागे जैसे हवा से उडाए बाइल भागते हैं

verses.sloka: पातिताश्च त्वया वीराः कृतं कर्म सुदुष्करम्।भक्षितानि च सैन्यानि प्राप्तं ते परमं यशः ।। ६.६७.५६ ।।
verses.transliteration: pātitāśca tvayā vīrāḥ kṛtaṁ karma suduṣkaram।bhakṣitāni ca sainyāni prāptaṁ te paramaṁ yaśaḥ ।। 6.67.56 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva spoke these words seeing Kumbhakarna who stood smeared with the blood of Vanaras and eating monkeys.

verses.sloka: त्यज तद्वानरानीकं प्राकृतैः किं करिष्यसि।सह स्वैकनिपातं मे पर्वतस्यास्य राक्षस ।। ६.६७.५७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tyaja tadvānarānīkaṁ prākṛtaiḥ kiṁ kariṣyasi।saha svaikanipātaṁ me parvatasyāsya rākṣasa ।। 6.67.57 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva spoke these words seeing Kumbhakarna who stood smeared with the blood of Vanaras and eating monkeys.
translations.hindi: गो ७ € आकाश में गर्जते हुए, सेशों की गजब i ससान कुम्भक की भयङ्कर गजेना सुन, बहुत से वावर भूमि पर वे, दी गिर पडे जैसे जड़ से कटा हुआ साल हा पेड गिर पड़ता ह

verses.sloka: तद्वाक्यं हरिराजस्य सत्त्वधैर्यसमन्वितम्।श्रुत्वा राक्षसशार्दूलः कुम्भकर्णो ऽब्रवीद्वचः ।। ६.६७.५८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadvākyaṁ harirājasya sattvadhairyasamanvitam।śrutvā rākṣasaśārdūlaḥ kumbhakarṇo 'bravīdvacaḥ ।। 6.67.58 ।।

translations.english: "Give up with Vanaras, who are monkeys by nature. Bear this one mountain's blow of mine."

verses.sloka: प्रजापतेस्तु पौत्रस्त्वं तथैवर्क्षरजस्सुतः।श्रुतपौरुषसम्पन्नः कस्माद्गर्जसि वानर ।। ६.६७.५९ ।।
verses.transliteration: prajāpatestu pautrastvaṁ tathaivarkṣarajassutaḥ।śrutapauruṣasampannaḥ kasmādgarjasi vānara ।। 6.67.59 ।।

translations.english: Hearing the king of Vanara's words of courage and strength, the tiger among Rakshasas, Kumbhakarna spoke these words.

verses.sloka: स कुम्भकर्णस्य वचो निशम्य व्याविध्य शैलं सहसा मुमोच।तेनाजघानोरसि कुम्भकर्णं शैलेन वज्राशनिसन्निभेन ।। ६.६७.६० ।।
verses.transliteration: sa kumbhakarṇasya vaco niśamya vyāvidhya śailaṁ sahasā mumoca।tenājaghānorasi kumbhakarṇaṁ śailena vajrāśanisannibhena ।। 6.67.60 ।।

translations.english: "O Vanara! You are the grandson of creator Brahma and son of Rksharaja, endowed with fortitude and so roaring like this."

verses.sloka: तच्छैलशृङ्गं सहसा विशीर्णं भुजान्तरे तस्य तदा विशाले।ततो विषेदुः सहसा प्लवङ्गा रक्षोगणाश्चापि मुदा विनेदुः ।। ६.६७.६१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tacchailaśṛṅgaṁ sahasā viśīrṇaṁ bhujāntare tasya tadā viśāle।tato viṣeduḥ sahasā plavaṅgā rakṣogaṇāścāpi mudā vineduḥ ।। 6.67.61 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Kumbhakarna's words, Sugriva forcibly discharged a mountain resembling a thunderbolt on the chest of Kumbhakarna.

verses.sloka: स शैलशृङ्गाभिहतश्चुकोप ननाद कोपाच्च विवृत्य वक्त्रम्।व्याविध्य शूलं च तडित्प्रकाशं चिक्षेप हर्यृक्षपतेर्वधाय ।। ६.६७.६२ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa śailaśṛṅgābhihataścukopa nanāda kopācca vivṛtya vaktram।vyāvidhya śūlaṁ ca taḍitprakāśaṁ cikṣepa haryṛkṣapatervadhāya ।। 6.67.62 ।।

translations.english: Then the mountain peak dropped on the chest broke into pieces. Thereafter the monkeys were despaired, and Rakshasas roared in joy.

verses.sloka: तत् कुम्भकर्णस्य भुजप्रविद्धं शूलं शितं काञ्चनधामजुष्टम्।क्षिप्रं समुत्पत्य निगृह्य दोर्भ्यां बभञ्ज वेगेन सुतो ऽनिलस्य ।। ६.६७.६३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tat kumbhakarṇasya bhujapraviddhaṁ śūlaṁ śitaṁ kāñcanadhāmajuṣṭam।kṣipraṁ samutpatya nigṛhya dorbhyāṁ babhañja vegena suto 'nilasya ।। 6.67.63 ।।

translations.english: Struck with mountain peaks, the Rakshasa became furious, and his pride was hurt. He opened his mouth widely making loud noises, his pike glowing like lightning, turned the pike into circles and hurled at Sugriva to put an end to him.

verses.sloka: कृतं भारसहस्रस्य शूलं कालायसं महत्।बभञ्ज जानुन्यारोप्य प्रहृष्टः प्लवगर्षभः ।। ६.६७.६४ ।।
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṁ bhārasahasrasya śūlaṁ kālāyasaṁ mahat।babhañja jānunyāropya prahṛṣṭaḥ plavagarṣabhaḥ ।। 6.67.64 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman the son of windgod instantly seized Kumbhakarna with his arms, whose shaft was covered by chains and broke with both hands quickly.

verses.sloka: शूलं भग्नं हनुमता दृष्ट्वा वानरवाहिनी।हृष्टा ननाद बहुशः सर्वतश्चापि दुद्रुवे ।। ६.६७.६५ ।।
verses.transliteration: śūlaṁ bhagnaṁ hanumatā dṛṣṭvā vānaravāhinī।hṛṣṭā nanāda bahuśaḥ sarvataścāpi dudruve ।। 6.67.65 ।।

translations.english: Then a rejoiced monkey, resting the thousand bharas iron pike on his knee broke it.

verses.sloka: सिंहनादं च ते चक्रुः प्रहृष्टा वनगोचराः।मारुतिं पूजयाञ्चक्रुर्दृष्ट्वा शूलं तथागतम् ।। ६.६७.६६ ।।
verses.transliteration: siṁhanādaṁ ca te cakruḥ prahṛṣṭā vanagocarāḥ।mārutiṁ pūjayāñcakrurdṛṣṭvā śūlaṁ tathāgatam ।। 6.67.66 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the pike broken by Hanuman, the army of Vanaras rejoiced and roared repeatedly all over and rushed.

verses.sloka: स तत्तदा भग्नमवेक्ष्य शूलं चुकोप रक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मा।उत्पाट्य लङ्कामलयात् स शृङ्गं जघान सुग्रीवमुपेत्य तेन ।। ६.६७.६७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tattadā bhagnamavekṣya śūlaṁ cukopa rakṣodhipatirmahātmā।utpāṭya laṅkāmalayāt sa śṛṅgaṁ jaghāna sugrīvamupetya tena ।। 6.67.67 ।।

translations.english: Rakshasa was dismayed and mellowed. The forest rangers rejoiced and roared like lions going round. Seeing the broken pike Vanaras applauded Hanuman.

verses.sloka: स शैलशृङ्गाभिहतो विसञ्ज्ञः पपात भूमौ युधि वानरेन्द्रः।तं प्रेक्ष्य भूमौ पतितं विसञ्ज्ञं नेदुः प्रहृष्टास्त्वथ यातुधानाः ।। ६.६७.६८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa śailaśṛṅgābhihato visañjñaḥ papāta bhūmau yudhi vānarendraḥ।taṁ prekṣya bhūmau patitaṁ visañjñaṁ neduḥ prahṛṣṭāstvatha yātudhānāḥ ।। 6.67.68 ।।

translations.english: That great soul, the Lord of Rakshasas seeing the pike broken in that way, was highly enraged. Taking Malaya Mountain from Lanka, he struck Sugriva who was approaching him.

verses.sloka: तमभ्युपेत्याद्भुतघोरवीर्यं स कुम्भकर्णो युधि वानरेन्द्रम्।जहार सुग्रीवमभिप्रगृह्य यथा ऽनिलो मेघमतिप्रचण्डः ।। ६.६७.६९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamabhyupetyādbhutaghoravīryaṁ sa kumbhakarṇo yudhi vānarendram।jahāra sugrīvamabhipragṛhya yathā 'nilo meghamatipracaṇḍaḥ ।। 6.67.69 ।।

translations.english: Struck by the piece of mountain the Vanara king became unconscious and dropped on the battlefield. Seeing that the Rakshasas were happy and naturally roared with a feeling of triumph.

verses.sloka: स तं महामेघनिकाशरूपमुत्पाट्य गच्छन् युधि कुम्भकर्णः।रराज मेरुप्रतिमानरूपो मेरुर्यथा ऽभ्युच्छ्रितघोरशृङ्गः ।। ६.६७.७० ।।
verses.transliteration: sa taṁ mahāmeghanikāśarūpamutpāṭya gacchan yudhi kumbhakarṇaḥ।rarāja merupratimānarūpo meruryathā 'bhyucchritaghoraśṛṅgaḥ ।। 6.67.70 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna approaching the Vanara Lord Sugriva endowed with wonderful and dreadful prowess, went like wind carrying clouds taking him.

verses.sloka: ततस्तमुत्पाट्य जगाम वीरः संस्तूयमानो युधि राक्षसेन्द्रैः।शृण्वन्निनादं त्रिदशालयानां प्लवङ्गराजग्रहविस्मितानाम् ।। ६.६७.७१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatastamutpāṭya jagāma vīraḥ saṁstūyamāno yudhi rākṣasendraiḥ।śṛṇvanninādaṁ tridaśālayānāṁ plavaṅgarājagrahavismitānām ।। 6.67.71 ।।

translations.english: In the battlefield, the form of Kumbhakarna which resembled a huge cloud was distinguished in appearance like the lofty peak of mountain Meru.

verses.sloka: ततस्तमादाय तदा स मेने हरीन्द्रमिन्द्रोपममिन्द्रवीर्यः।अस्मिन् हृते सर्वमिदं हृतं स्यात् सराघवं सैन्यमितीन्द्रशत्रुः ।। ६.६७.७२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatastamādāya tadā sa mene harīndramindropamamindravīryaḥ।asmin hṛte sarvamidaṁ hṛtaṁ syāt sarāghavaṁ sainyamitīndraśatruḥ ।। 6.67.72 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter the heroic Rakshasa king having held Sugriva in the battle went, duly praised (by Rakshasas), hearing the roaring sounds of gods in heaven wondering at Sugriva's capture.

verses.sloka: विद्रुतां वाहिनीं दृष्ट्वा वानराणां ततस्ततः।कुम्भकर्णेन सुग्रीवं गृहीतं चापि वानरम् ।। ६.६७.७३ ।।
verses.transliteration: vidrutāṁ vāhinīṁ dṛṣṭvā vānarāṇāṁ tatastataḥ।kumbhakarṇena sugrīvaṁ gṛhītaṁ cāpi vānaram ।। 6.67.73 ।।

translations.english: Then Kumbhakarna, an enemy of Indra, who was equal to Indra in heroism seizing Sugriva, the Indra of monkeys, who is equal to Indra, thought, 'If Sugriva is killed it is like killing all the army including Rama.'

verses.sloka: हनुमांश्चिन्तयामास मतिमान् मारुतात्मजः।एवं गृहीते सुग्रीवे किं कर्तव्यं मया भवेत् ।। ६.६७.७४ ।।
verses.transliteration: hanumāṁścintayāmāsa matimān mārutātmajaḥ।evaṁ gṛhīte sugrīve kiṁ kartavyaṁ mayā bhavet ।। 6.67.74 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the army running away here and there and Sugriva being captured by Kumbhakarna, wise Hanuman, the son of Maruti started thinking.

verses.sloka: यद्वै न्याय्यं मया कर्तुं तत् करिष्यामि सर्वथा।भूत्वा पर्वतसङ्काशो नाशयिष्यामि राक्षसम् ।। ६.६७.७५ ।।
verses.transliteration: yadvai nyāyyaṁ mayā kartuṁ tat kariṣyāmi sarvathā।bhūtvā parvatasaṅkāśo nāśayiṣyāmi rākṣasam ।। 6.67.75 ।।

translations.english: 'Sugriva has been caught. What is my duty now? I will do what is just. I will destroy that Rakshasa who is in the form of a mountain', thought Maruti.

verses.sloka: मया हते संयति कुम्भकर्णे महाबले मुष्टिविकीर्णदेहे।विमोचिते वानरपार्थिवे च भवन्तु हृष्टाः प्लवगाः समस्ताः ।। ६.६७.७६ ।।
verses.transliteration: mayā hate saṁyati kumbhakarṇe mahābale muṣṭivikīrṇadehe।vimocite vānarapārthive ca bhavantu hṛṣṭāḥ plavagāḥ samastāḥ ।। 6.67.76 ।।

translations.english: 'Sugriva has been caught. What is my duty now? I will do what is just. I will destroy that Rakshasa who is in the form of a mountain', thought Maruti.

verses.sloka: अथवा स्वयमप्येष मोक्षं प्राप्स्यति पार्थिवः।गृहीतो ऽयं यदि भवेत्ऺित्रदशैः सासुरोरगैः ।। ६.६७.७७ ।।
verses.transliteration: athavā svayamapyeṣa mokṣaṁ prāpsyati pārthivaḥ।gṛhīto 'yaṁ yadi bhavetऺitradaśaiḥ sāsuroragaiḥ ।। 6.67.77 ।।

translations.english: 'Mighty Kumbhakarna shattered by my fist in a duel, and the king of Vanaras delivered, all the monkeys will be rejoiced.'

verses.sloka: मन्ये न तावदात्मानं बुद्ध्यते वानराधिपः।शैलप्रहाराभिहतः कुम्भकर्णेन संयुगे ।। ६.६७.७८ ।।
verses.transliteration: manye na tāvadātmānaṁ buddhyate vānarādhipaḥ।śailaprahārābhihataḥ kumbhakarṇena saṁyuge ।। 6.67.78 ।।

translations.english: 'Or else this Sugriva alone can get liberated by fighting by himself with gods, demons and Nagas also, even if he is captured'.

verses.sloka: अयं मुहूर्तात् सुग्रीवो लब्धसञ्ज्ञो महाहवे।आत्मनो वानराणां च यत् पथ्यं तत् करिष्यति ।। ६.६७.७९ ।।
verses.transliteration: ayaṁ muhūrtāt sugrīvo labdhasañjño mahāhave।ātmano vānarāṇāṁ ca yat pathyaṁ tat kariṣyati ।। 6.67.79 ।।

translations.english: "I think that Sugriva, hit by Kumbhakarna with a mountain, has lost senses and is not able to know."

verses.sloka: मया तु मोक्षितस्यास्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः।अप्रीतिश्च भवेत् कष्टा कीर्तिनाशश्च शाश्वतः ।। ६.६७.८० ।।
verses.transliteration: mayā tu mokṣitasyāsya sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ।aprītiśca bhavet kaṣṭā kīrtināśaśca śāśvataḥ ।। 6.67.80 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva will soon regain consciousness and do what is good for Vanaras.

verses.sloka: तस्मान्मुहूर्तं काङ्क्षिष्ये विक्रमं पार्थिवस्य तु।भिन्नं च वानरानीकं तावदाश्वासयाम्यहम् ।। ६.६७.८१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmānmuhūrtaṁ kāṅkṣiṣye vikramaṁ pārthivasya tu।bhinnaṁ ca vānarānīkaṁ tāvadāśvāsayāmyaham ।। 6.67.81 ।।

translations.english: "If Sugriva is released by me, he will not be happy forever. His fame will be lost."

verses.sloka: इत्येवं चिन्तयित्वा तु हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः।भूयः संस्तम्भयामास वानराणां महाचमूम् ।। ६.६७.८२ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityevaṁ cintayitvā tu hanumān mārutātmajaḥ।bhūyaḥ saṁstambhayāmāsa vānarāṇāṁ mahācamūm ।। 6.67.82 ।।

translations.english: "Therefore, I will see the exhibition of his prowess for a while. Thereafter I shall reinforce the scattered army of Vanaras."

verses.sloka: स कुम्भकर्णो ऽथ विवेश लङ्कां स्फुरन्तमादाय महाकपिं तम्।विमानचर्यागृहगोपुरस्थैः पुष्पाग्र्यवर्षैरवकीर्यमाणः ।। ६.६७.८३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa kumbhakarṇo 'tha viveśa laṅkāṁ sphurantamādāya mahākapiṁ tam।vimānacaryāgṛhagopurasthaiḥ puṣpāgryavarṣairavakīryamāṇaḥ ।। 6.67.83 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the son of Maruti thinking in this way said to the Vanara army and brought determination.

verses.sloka: लाजगन्धोदवर्षैस्तु सिच्यमानः शनैःशनैः।राजमार्गस्य शीतत्वात् सञ्ज्ञामाप महाबलः ।। ६.६७.८४ ।।
verses.transliteration: lājagandhodavarṣaistu sicyamānaḥ śanaiḥśanaiḥ।rājamārgasya śītatvāt sañjñāmāpa mahābalaḥ ।। 6.67.84 ।।

translations.english: Then Kumbhakarna taking the great Vanara who started to shake by then, entered Lanka through the roads of lofty mansions from where Rakshasas hailed showering flowers.

verses.sloka: ततः स सञ्ज्ञामुपलभ्य कृच्छ्राद्वलीयसस्तस्य भुजान्तरस्थः।अवेक्षमाणः पुरराजमार्गं विचिन्तयामास मुहुर्महात्मा ।। ६.६७.८५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa sañjñāmupalabhya kṛcchrādvalīyasastasya bhujāntarasthaḥ।avekṣamāṇaḥ purarājamārgaṁ vicintayāmāsa muhurmahātmā ।। 6.67.85 ।।

translations.english: Exceptionally strong Sugriva with parched grain and fragrant water showered on him in the royal path, being cool, regained consciousness.

verses.sloka: एवं गृहीतेन कथं नु नाम शक्यं मया सम्प्रतिकर्तुमद्य।तथा करिष्यामि यथा हरीणां भविष्यतीष्टं च हितं च कार्यम् ।। ६.६७.८६ ।।
verses.transliteration: evaṁ gṛhītena kathaṁ nu nāma śakyaṁ mayā sampratikartumadya।tathā kariṣyāmi yathā harīṇāṁ bhaviṣyatīṣṭaṁ ca hitaṁ ca kāryam ।। 6.67.86 ।।

translations.english: (Sugriva) being strong and painfully gained senses, from the arms of the great Rakshasa, started looking at the royal path of the city. He was bewildered and started pondering this way.

verses.sloka: ततः कराग्रैः सहसा समेत्य राजा हरीणाममरेन्द्रशत्रुम्।खरैश्च कर्णौ दशनैश्च नासां ददंश पार्श्वेषु च कुम्भकर्णम् ।। ६.६७.८७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ karāgraiḥ sahasā sametya rājā harīṇāmamarendraśatrum।kharaiśca karṇau daśanaiśca nāsāṁ dadaṁśa pārśveṣu ca kumbhakarṇam ।। 6.67.87 ।।

translations.english: 'Caught in this way, how can I do (take action)? I will do what is possible, pleasing, and good to Vanaras now.'

verses.sloka: स कुम्भकर्णो हृतकर्णनासो विदारितस्तेन विमर्दितश्च।रोषाभिभूतः क्षतजार्द्रगात्रः सुग्रीवमाविध्य पिपेष भूमौ ।। ६.६७.८८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa kumbhakarṇo hṛtakarṇanāso vidāritastena vimarditaśca।roṣābhibhūtaḥ kṣatajārdragātraḥ sugrīvamāvidhya pipeṣa bhūmau ।। 6.67.88 ।।

translations.english: There after the king of Vanaras decided to act and tore off the ears of the enemy ruler of gods (Kumbhakarna) with his sharp nails, bit off the nose with his teeth, and sides of Kumbhakarna.

verses.sloka: स भूतले भीमबलाभिपिष्टः सुरारिभिस्तैरभिहन्यमानः।जगाम खं वेगवदभ्युपेत्य पुनश्च रामेण समाजगाम ।। ६.६७.८९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa bhūtale bhīmabalābhipiṣṭaḥ surāribhistairabhihanyamānaḥ।jagāma khaṁ vegavadabhyupetya punaśca rāmeṇa samājagāma ।। 6.67.89 ।।

translations.english: Deprived of ears and nose by Sugriva, splitting with nails and teeth, Kumbhakarna was highly furious and pinning down Sugriva pounded him against the ground, limbs bespattered.

verses.sloka: कर्णनासाविहीनस्तु कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः।रराज शोणितैः सिक्तो गिरिः प्रस्रवणैरिव ।। ६.६७.९० ।।
verses.transliteration: karṇanāsāvihīnastu kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ।rarāja śoṇitaiḥ sikto giriḥ prasravaṇairiva ।। 6.67.90 ।।

translations.english: Dropped on the ground by Kumbhakarna of dreadful strength, pressed against the ground surface, Sugriva bounced to the sky to get reunited with Rama.

verses.sloka: शोणितार्द्रो महाकायो राक्षसो भीमविक्रमः।युद्धायाभिमुखो भूयो मनश्चके महाबलः ।। ६.६७.९१ ।।
verses.transliteration: śoṇitārdro mahākāyo rākṣaso bhīmavikramaḥ।yuddhāyābhimukho bhūyo manaścake mahābalaḥ ।। 6.67.91 ।।

translations.english: Great hero Kumbhakarna, devoid of ears and nose drenched in blood shone like a mountain in springs.

verses.sloka: अमर्षाच्छोणितोद्गरी शुशुभे रावणानुजः।नीलाञ्जनचयप्रख्यः ससन्ध्य इव तोयदः ।। ६.६७.९२ ।।
verses.transliteration: amarṣācchoṇitodgarī śuśubhe rāvaṇānujaḥ।nīlāñjanacayaprakhyaḥ sasandhya iva toyadaḥ ।। 6.67.92 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna of terrific valour and gigantic body, drenched in blood, dark in colour like a mountain of collyrium, resembling evening cloud, the night ranger went towards the battlefield.

verses.sloka: गते तु तस्मिन् सुरराजशत्रुः क्रोधात् प्रदुद्राव रणाय भूयः।अनायुधो ऽस्मीति विचिन्त्य रौद्रो घोरं तदा मुद्गरमाससाद ।। ६.६७.९३ ।।
verses.transliteration: gate tu tasmin surarājaśatruḥ krodhāt pradudrāva raṇāya bhūyaḥ।anāyudho 'smīti vicintya raudro ghoraṁ tadā mudgaramāsasāda ।। 6.67.93 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna of terrific valour and gigantic body, drenched in blood, dark in colour like a mountain of collyrium, resembling evening cloud, the night ranger went towards the battlefield.

verses.sloka: ततः स पुर्याः सहसा महौजा निष्क्रम्य तद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रम्।बभक्ष रक्षो युधि कुम्भकर्णः प्रजा युगान्ताग्निरिव प्रदीप्तः ।। ६.६७.९४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa puryāḥ sahasā mahaujā niṣkramya tadvānarasainyamugram।babhakṣa rakṣo yudhi kumbhakarṇaḥ prajā yugāntāgniriva pradīptaḥ ।। 6.67.94 ।।

translations.english: Himself (Sugriva) gone, the enemy of the Lord of gods rushed again retreating, "I am ferocious, without weapon." Then seizing an iron mallet, Sugriva went reflecting.

verses.sloka: बुभुक्षितः शोणितमांसगृध्नुः प्रविश्य तद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रम्।चखाद रक्षांसि हरीन् पिशाचानृक्षांश्च मोहाद्युधि कुम्भकर्णः ।। ६.६७.९५ ।।
verses.transliteration: bubhukṣitaḥ śoṇitamāṁsagṛdhnuḥ praviśya tadvānarasainyamugram।cakhāda rakṣāṁsi harīn piśācānṛkṣāṁśca mohādyudhi kumbhakarṇaḥ ।। 6.67.95 ।।

translations.english: The great Kumbhakarna then departing instantly entered into Vanara army consumed them as fire at dissolution consumed people.

verses.sloka: यथैव मृत्युर्हरते युगान्ते स भक्षयामास हरींश्च मुख्यान् ।। ६.६७.९६ ।।
verses.transliteration: yathaiva mṛtyurharate yugānte sa bhakṣayāmāsa harīṁśca mukhyān ।। 6.67.96 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna started seizing principal monkeys in the same way as death at the end of universe. Being famished for flesh and blood he entered the Vanara army in delusion and consumed not only Vanaras but Rakshasas, demons and bears also.

verses.sloka: एकं द्वे त्रीन् बहून् क्रुद्धो वानरान् सह राक्षसैः।समादायैकहस्तेन प्रचिक्षेप त्वरन् मुखे ।। ६.६७.९७ ।।
verses.transliteration: ekaṁ dve trīn bahūn kruddho vānarān saha rākṣasaiḥ।samādāyaikahastena pracikṣepa tvaran mukhe ।। 6.67.97 ।।

translations.english: Taking one, two, three, and many Vanaras along with Rakshasas hastily with one hand he was gulping them.

verses.sloka: सम्प्रस्रवंस्तदा मेदः शोणितं च महाबलः।वध्यमानो नगेन्द्राग्रैर्भक्षयामास वानरान् ।। ६.६७.९८ ।।
verses.transliteration: samprasravaṁstadā medaḥ śoṇitaṁ ca mahābalaḥ।vadhyamāno nagendrāgrairbhakṣayāmāsa vānarān ।। 6.67.98 ।।

translations.english: Then the mighty Kumbhakarna while being struck by peaks of mountains, he was feasting on Vanaras fat and blood oozing out from his mouth.

verses.sloka: ते भक्ष्यमाणा हरयो रामं जग्मुस्तदा गतिम् ।। ६.६७.९९ ।।
verses.transliteration: te bhakṣyamāṇā harayo rāmaṁ jagmustadā gatim ।। 6.67.99 ।।

translations.english: Being devoured by Kumbhakarna, the Vanaras went for refuge to Rama. Enraged Kumbhakarna followed the Vanaras behind.

verses.sloka: कुम्भकर्णो भृशं क्रुद्धः कपीन् खादन् प्रधावति ।। ६.६७.१०० ।।
verses.transliteration: kumbhakarṇo bhṛśaṁ kruddhaḥ kapīn khādan pradhāvati ।। 6.67.100 ।।

translations.english: Stretching his arms on all sides picking hundred, seven hundred, eight hundred and two hundred and three hundred, he ran devouring the vanaras.

verses.sloka: शतानि सप्त चाष्टौ च विंशत्ऺित्रंशत्तथैव च।सम्परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्यां खादन् विपरिधावति ।। ६.६७.१०१ ।।
verses.transliteration: śatāni sapta cāṣṭau ca viṁśatऺitraṁśattathaiva ca।sampariṣvajya bāhubhyāṁ khādan viparidhāvati ।। 6.67.101 ।।

translations.english: His limbs smeared with fat and blood, with wreaths of entrails hanging on his ears, with sharp teeth, grown in his body to huge size, rained darts like the spirit of death at the end of the world.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् काले सुमित्रायाः पुत्रः परबलार्दनः।चकार लक्ष्मणः क्रुद्धो युद्धं परपुरञ्जयः ।। ६.६७.१०२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmin kāle sumitrāyāḥ putraḥ parabalārdanaḥ।cakāra lakṣmaṇaḥ kruddho yuddhaṁ parapurañjayaḥ ।। 6.67.102 ।।

translations.english: At that time, Sumitra's son, Lakshmana, winner of enemy forces, conqueror of forts, enraged went to fight.

verses.sloka: स कुम्भकर्णस्य शरान् शरीरे सप्त वीर्यवान्।निचखानाददे बाणान् विससर्ज च लक्ष्मणः ।। ६.६७.१०३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa kumbhakarṇasya śarān śarīre sapta vīryavān।nicakhānādade bāṇān visasarja ca lakṣmaṇaḥ ।। 6.67.103 ।।

translations.english: Valiant Lakshmana pierced seven arrows on Kumbhakarna's body and discharged many arrows on him.

verses.sloka: अतिक्रम्य च सौमित्रिं कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः।राममेवाभिदुद्राव दारयन्निव मेदिनीम् ।। ६.६७.१०४ ।।
verses.transliteration: atikramya ca saumitriṁ kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ।rāmamevābhidudrāva dārayanniva medinīm ।। 6.67.104 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna having been tormented, put an end to the dart (of Lakshmana). Mighty Lakshmana there upon flew into a rage.

verses.sloka: अथ दाशरथी रामो रौद्रमस्त्रं प्रयोजयन्।कुम्भकर्णस्य हृदये ससर्ज निशितान् शरान् ।। ६.६७.१०५ ।।
verses.transliteration: atha dāśarathī rāmo raudramastraṁ prayojayan।kumbhakarṇasya hṛdaye sasarja niśitān śarān ।। 6.67.105 ।।

translations.english: Then he covered Kumbhakarna's glittering golden shield with arrows just as the evening wind covered the cloud.

verses.sloka: तस्य रामेण विद्धस्य सहसा ऽभिप्रधावतः।अङ्गारमित्राः क्रुद्धस्य मुखान्निश्चेरुरर्चिषः ।। ६.६७.१०६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya rāmeṇa viddhasya sahasā 'bhipradhāvataḥ।aṅgāramitrāḥ kruddhasya mukhānniścerurarciṣaḥ ।। 6.67.106 ।।

translations.english: Adorned with golden ornaments (Kumbhakarna), covered with darts without being tormented he looked like a dark mountain shining like sun rays covered by clouds.

verses.sloka: रामास्त्रविद्धो घोरं वै नदन् राक्षसपुङ्गवः।अभ्यधावत सङ्क्रुद्धो हरीन् विद्रावयन् रणे ।। ६.६७.१०७ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāmāstraviddho ghoraṁ vai nadan rākṣasapuṅgavaḥ।abhyadhāvata saṅkruddho harīn vidrāvayan raṇe ।। 6.67.107 ।।

translations.english: Thereupon the Rakshasa sounding like the rumblings of clouds disdainfully spoke these words to Lakshmana, the son of Sumitra.

verses.sloka: तस्योरसि निमग्नाश्च शरा बर्हिणवाससः।हस्ताच्चापि परिभ्रष्टा पपातोर्व्यां महागदा।आयुधानि च सर्वाणि विप्रकीर्यन्त भूतले ।। ६.६७.१०८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasyorasi nimagnāśca śarā barhiṇavāsasaḥ।hastāccāpi paribhraṣṭā papātorvyāṁ mahāgadā।āyudhāni ca sarvāṇi viprakīryanta bhūtale ।। 6.67.108 ।।

translations.english: "You have exhibited your valour without fear in battle, challenging me who has conquered even Lord of Death without difficulty in battle."

verses.sloka: स निरायुधमात्मानं यदा मेने महाबलः।मुष्टिभ्यां चरणाभ्यां च चकार कदनं महत् ।। ६.६७.१०९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa nirāyudhamātmānaṁ yadā mene mahābalaḥ।muṣṭibhyāṁ caraṇābhyāṁ ca cakāra kadanaṁ mahat ।। 6.67.109 ।।

translations.english: "He who is ready to face me, a rival of Lord of Death in conflict, with weapons in hand in great battle is worthy of honour to me."

verses.sloka: स बाणैरतिविद्धाङ्गः क्षतजेन समुक्षितः।रुधिरं प्रतिसुस्राव गिरिः प्रस्रवणं यथा ।। ६.६७.११० ।।
verses.transliteration: sa bāṇairatividdhāṅgaḥ kṣatajena samukṣitaḥ।rudhiraṁ pratisusrāva giriḥ prasravaṇaṁ yathā ।। 6.67.110 ।।

translations.english: "Indra mounted on the elephant, Airavata surrounded by all Devatas, indeed never stood before me in conflict."

verses.sloka: स तीर्वेण च कोपेन रुधिरेण च मूर्च्छितः।वानरान् राक्षसानृक्षान् खादन् विपरिधावति ।। ६.६७.१११ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tīrveṇa ca kopena rudhireṇa ca mūrcchitaḥ।vānarān rākṣasānṛkṣān khādan viparidhāvati ।। 6.67.111 ।।

translations.english: "Now I am gratified with your valour, though young. Taking leave of you, I wish to go to Raghava."

verses.sloka: अथ शृङ्गं समाविध्य भीमं भीमपराक्रमः।चिक्षेप राममुद्दिश्य बलवानन्तकोपमः ।। ६.६७.११२ ।।
verses.transliteration: atha śṛṅgaṁ samāvidhya bhīmaṁ bhīmaparākramaḥ।cikṣepa rāmamuddiśya balavānantakopamaḥ ।। 6.67.112 ।।

translations.english: "I am gratified by your valour, strength and enthusiasm which has been exhibited by you in the battle. However, I wish to kill Rama alone."

verses.sloka: अप्राप्तमन्तरा रामः सप्तभिस्तैरजिह्मगैः।शरैः काञ्चनचित्राङ्गैश्चिच्छेद पुरुषर्षभः ।। ६.६७.११३ ।।
verses.transliteration: aprāptamantarā rāmaḥ saptabhistairajihmagaiḥ।śaraiḥ kāñcanacitrāṅgaiściccheda puruṣarṣabhaḥ ।। 6.67.113 ।।

translations.english: "When Rama has been put to an end by me in conflict, whoever remains can be struck down by my army."

verses.sloka: तन्मेरुशिखराकारं द्योतमानमिव श्रिया।द्वे शते वानरेन्द्राणां पतमानमपातयत् ।। ६.६७.११४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tanmeruśikharākāraṁ dyotamānamiva śriyā।dve śate vānarendrāṇāṁ patamānamapātayat ।। 6.67.114 ।।

translations.english: When that Rakshasa made such boastful and dreadful statements in the battlefield, laughing heartily, Saumitri replied as follows.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् काले स धर्मात्मा लक्ष्मणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।कुम्भकर्णवधे युक्तो योगान् परिमृशन् बहून् ।। ६.६७.११५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmin kāle sa dharmātmā lakṣmaṇo vākyamabravīt।kumbhakarṇavadhe yukto yogān parimṛśan bahūn ।। 6.67.115 ।।

translations.english: "O Hero! that heroism you have acquired is irresistible even by Indra is true. Now your prowess has been witnessed. Rama stands here, immovable like a mountain."

verses.sloka: नैवायं वानरान् राजन्नापि जानाति राक्षसान्।मत्तः शोणितगन्धेन स्वान् परांश्चैव खादति ।। ६.६७.११६ ।।
verses.transliteration: naivāyaṁ vānarān rājannāpi jānāti rākṣasān।mattaḥ śoṇitagandhena svān parāṁścaiva khādati ।। 6.67.116 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna of mighty strength, the night ranger hearing Lakshmana, rather disregarding his words, overlooking him went alone towards Rama as if shaking the earth.

verses.sloka: साध्वेनमधिरोहन्तु सर्वे ते वानरर्षभाः।यूथपाश्च यथा मुख्यास्तिष्ठन्त्वस्य समन्ततः ।। ६.६७.११७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sādhvenamadhirohantu sarve te vānararṣabhāḥ।yūthapāśca yathā mukhyāstiṣṭhantvasya samantataḥ ।। 6.67.117 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna of mighty strength, the night ranger hearing Lakshmana, rather disregarding his words, overlooking him went alone towards Rama as if shaking the earth.

verses.sloka: अप्ययं दुर्मतिः काले गुरुभारप्रपीडितः।प्रपतन् राक्षसो भूमौ नान्यान् हन्यात् प्लवङ्गमान् ।। ६.६७.११८ ।।
verses.transliteration: apyayaṁ durmatiḥ kāle gurubhāraprapīḍitaḥ।prapatan rākṣaso bhūmau nānyān hanyāt plavaṅgamān ।। 6.67.118 ।।

translations.english: Sri Rama, son of Dasaratha, now released a sharp arrow presided over by Rudra and fixed into the chest of Kumbhakarna.

verses.sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राजपुत्रस्य धीमतः।ते समारुरुहुर्हृष्टाः कुम्भकर्णं प्लवङ्गमाः ।। ६.६७.११९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā rājaputrasya dhīmataḥ।te samāruruhurhṛṣṭāḥ kumbhakarṇaṁ plavaṅgamāḥ ।। 6.67.119 ।।

translations.english: As Rama hit in anger, at once fire mixed with flames shot forth from Kumbhakarna's mouth.

verses.sloka: कुम्भकर्णस्तु सङ्क्रुद्धः समारूढः प्लवङ्गमैः।व्यधूनयत्तान् वेगेन दुष्टहस्तीव हस्तिपान् ।। ६.६७.१२० ।।
verses.transliteration: kumbhakarṇastu saṅkruddhaḥ samārūḍhaḥ plavaṅgamaiḥ।vyadhūnayattān vegena duṣṭahastīva hastipān ।। 6.67.120 ।।

translations.english: Pierced by Rama's missiles, the foremost of the Rakshasas, Kumbhakarna was very angry and rushed towards him dispersing all the vanaras in the battle.

verses.sloka: तान् दृष्ट्वा निर्धुतान् रामो दुष्टो ऽयमिति राक्षसः।सुमुत्पपात वेगेन धनुरुत्तममाददे ।। ६.६७.१२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tān dṛṣṭvā nirdhutān rāmo duṣṭo 'yamiti rākṣasaḥ।sumutpapāta vegena dhanuruttamamādade ।। 6.67.121 ।।

translations.english: Adorned by peacock's plumes, those arrows slipped into his breast, he lost senses, his mace naturally dropped down from his hand.

verses.sloka: क्रोधताम्रेक्षणो वीरो निर्दहन्निव चक्षुषा।राघवो राक्षसं रोषादभिदुद्राव वेगितः।यूथपान् हर्षयन् सर्वान् कुम्भकर्णभयार्दितान् ।। ६.६७.१२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: krodhatāmrekṣaṇo vīro nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā।rāghavo rākṣasaṁ roṣādabhidudrāva vegitaḥ।yūthapān harṣayan sarvān kumbhakarṇabhayārditān ।। 6.67.122 ।।

translations.english: All his weapons scattered on the ground, the mighty Kumbhakarna deprived of weapons thought for himself and created havoc with his feet and fists.

verses.sloka: स चापमादाय भुजङ्गकल्पं दृढज्यमुग्रं तपनीयचित्रम्।हरीन् समाश्वास्य समुत्पपात रामो निबद्धोत्तमतूणबाणः ।। ६.६७.१२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa cāpamādāya bhujaṅgakalpaṁ dṛḍhajyamugraṁ tapanīyacitram।harīn samāśvāsya samutpapāta rāmo nibaddhottamatūṇabāṇaḥ ।। 6.67.123 ।।

translations.english: Pierced by arrows excessively all over his limbs, bathing in blood flowing from the injury was like a mountain with a spring.

verses.sloka: स वानरगणैस्तैस्तु वृतः परमदुर्जयः।लक्ष्मणानुचरो रामः सम्प्रतस्थे महावलः ।। ६.६७.१२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa vānaragaṇaistaistu vṛtaḥ paramadurjayaḥ।lakṣmaṇānucaro rāmaḥ sampratasthe mahāvalaḥ ।। 6.67.124 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna in violent anger, blood flowing from the injury, went about devouring Vanaras, Rakshasas and bears.

verses.sloka: स ददर्श महात्मानं किरीटिनमरिन्दमम्।शोणिताप्लुतसर्वाङ्गं कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् ।। ६.६७.१२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa dadarśa mahātmānaṁ kirīṭinamarindamam।śoṇitāplutasarvāṅgaṁ kumbhakarṇaṁ mahābalam ।। 6.67.125 ।।

translations.english: Thereupon, Kumbhakarna endowed with terrific valour like God of Death hurled towards Rama a mountain peak whirling it round which split.

verses.sloka: सर्वान् समभिधावन्तं यथा रुष्टं दिशागजम्।मार्गमाणं हरीन् क्रुद्धं राक्षसैः परिवारितम् ।। ६.६७.१२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarvān samabhidhāvantaṁ yathā ruṣṭaṁ diśāgajam।mārgamāṇaṁ harīn kruddhaṁ rākṣasaiḥ parivāritam ।। 6.67.126 ।।

translations.english: Rama once again taking the bow, split the peak of the mountain with seven unfailing arrows on its way even before it reached the target.

verses.sloka: विन्ध्यमन्दरसङ्काशं काञ्चनाङ्गदभूषणम्।स्रवन्तं रुधिरं वक्त्राद्वर्षमेघमिवोत्थितम् ।। ६.६७.१२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: vindhyamandarasaṅkāśaṁ kāñcanāṅgadabhūṣaṇam।sravantaṁ rudhiraṁ vaktrādvarṣameghamivotthitam ।। 6.67.127 ।।

translations.english: The righteous Rama, a bull among men, taking his arrows adorned with gold split the peak of the mountain.

verses.sloka: जिह्वया परिलिह्यन्तं शोणितं शोणितेक्षणम्।मृद्नन्तं वानरानीकं कालान्तकयमोपमम् ।। ६.६७.१२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: jihvayā parilihyantaṁ śoṇitaṁ śoṇitekṣaṇam।mṛdnantaṁ vānarānīkaṁ kālāntakayamopamam ।। 6.67.128 ।।

translations.english: While falling down, Kumbhakarna was like Mount Meru, shining by his splendour was falling down and knocking down two hundred monkeys.

verses.sloka: तं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसश्रेष्ठं प्रदीप्तानलवर्चसम्।विस्फारयामास तदा कार्मुकं पुरुषर्षभः ।। ६.६७.१२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasaśreṣṭhaṁ pradīptānalavarcasam।visphārayāmāsa tadā kārmukaṁ puruṣarṣabhaḥ ।। 6.67.129 ।।

translations.english: At that time, righteous Lakshmana who was attentively deliberating on many plans to kill Kumbhakarna, said to Rama.

verses.sloka: स तस्य चापनिर्घोषात् कुपितो राक्षसर्षभः।अमृष्यमाणस्तं घोषमभिदुद्राव राघवम् ।। ६.६७.१३० ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tasya cāpanirghoṣāt kupito rākṣasarṣabhaḥ।amṛṣyamāṇastaṁ ghoṣamabhidudrāva rāghavam ।। 6.67.130 ।।

translations.english: "This king intoxicated with the smell of blood is not knowing his own people and foes and devouring both Vanaras and Rakshasas."

verses.sloka: ततस्तु वातोद्धतमेघकल्पं भुजङ्गराजोत्तमभोगबाहुम्।तमापतन्तं धरणीधराभमुवाच रामो युधि कुम्भकर्णम् ।। ६.६७.१३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatastu vātoddhatameghakalpaṁ bhujaṅgarājottamabhogabāhum।tamāpatantaṁ dharaṇīdharābhamuvāca rāmo yudhi kumbhakarṇam ।। 6.67.131 ।।

translations.english: Let the bulls among Vanaras climb upon him and the foremost of Vanaras and the troops stand all over.

verses.sloka: आगच्छ रक्षोधिप मा विषादमवस्थितो ऽहं प्रगृहीतचापः।अवेहि मां शक्रसपत्न रामं मया मुहूर्ताद्भविता विचेताः ।। ६.६७.१३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: āgaccha rakṣodhipa mā viṣādamavasthito 'haṁ pragṛhītacāpaḥ।avehi māṁ śakrasapatna rāmaṁ mayā muhūrtādbhavitā vicetāḥ ।। 6.67.132 ।।

translations.english: Distressed by heavy weight unable to get up evil minded Rakshasa fallen on the ground will not destroy monkeys.

verses.sloka: रामो ऽयमिति विज्ञाय जहास विकृतस्वनम्।अभ्यधावत सङ्क्रुद्धो हरीन् विद्रावयन् रणे ।। ६.६७.१३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāmo 'yamiti vijñāya jahāsa vikṛtasvanam।abhyadhāvata saṅkruddho harīn vidrāvayan raṇe ।। 6.67.133 ।।

translations.english: Having heard the words of the wise Prince, the monkeys collected climbed on Kumbhakarna happily.

verses.sloka: पातयन्निव सर्वेषां हृदयानि वनौकसाम् ।। ६.६७.१३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: pātayanniva sarveṣāṁ hṛdayāni vanaukasām ।। 6.67.134 ।।

translations.english: Enraged Kumbhakarna shook off the monkeys climbed on his body like a harsh elephant shakes off its rider.

verses.sloka: प्रहस्य विकृतं भीमं स मेघस्तनितोपमम्।कुम्भकर्णो महातेजा राघवं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.६७.१३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: prahasya vikṛtaṁ bhīmaṁ sa meghastanitopamam।kumbhakarṇo mahātejā rāghavaṁ vākyamabravīt ।। 6.67.135 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the Vanaras shaken, Rama went towards the Rakshasa instantly and took out his best bow.

verses.sloka: नाहं विराधो विज्ञेयो न कबन्धः खरो न च।न वाली न च मारीचः कुम्भकर्णो ऽहमागतः ।। ६.६७.१३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: nāhaṁ virādho vijñeyo na kabandhaḥ kharo na ca।na vālī na ca mārīcaḥ kumbhakarṇo 'hamāgataḥ ।। 6.67.136 ।।

translations.english: Raghava's eyes turned red with anger, went quickly in anger as monkeys and troop leaders oppressed by Kumbhakarna were rejoiced.

verses.sloka: पश्य मे मुद्गरं घोरं सर्वकालायसं महत्।अनेन निर्जिता देवा दानवाश्च पुरा मया ।। ६.६७.१३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: paśya me mudgaraṁ ghoraṁ sarvakālāyasaṁ mahat।anena nirjitā devā dānavāśca purā mayā ।। 6.67.137 ।।

translations.english: Raghava's eyes turned red with anger, went quickly in anger as monkeys and troop leaders oppressed by Kumbhakarna were rejoiced.

verses.sloka: विकर्णनास इति मां नावज्ञातुं त्वमर्हसि।स्वल्पा ऽपि हि न मे पीडा कर्णनासाविनाशनात् ।। ६.६७.१३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: vikarṇanāsa iti māṁ nāvajñātuṁ tvamarhasi।svalpā 'pi hi na me pīḍā karṇanāsāvināśanāt ।। 6.67.138 ।।

translations.english: Rama, taking a formidable bow which resembled a great serpent, with a quiver full of excellent arrows shining in gold that looked beautiful, went forward restoring the confidence of the monkeys.

verses.sloka: दर्शयेक्ष्वाकुशार्दूल वीर्यं गात्रेषु मे लघु।ततस्त्वां भक्षयिष्यामि दृष्टपौरुषविक्रमम् ।। ६.६७.१३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: darśayekṣvākuśārdūla vīryaṁ gātreṣu me laghu।tatastvāṁ bhakṣayiṣyāmi dṛṣṭapauruṣavikramam ।। 6.67.139 ।।

translations.english: Mighty Rama, who is extremely difficult to win over, went with full conviction followed by Lakshmana and surrounded by vanara troops.

verses.sloka: स कुम्भकर्णस्य वचो निशम्य रामः सुपुङ्खान् विससर्ज बाणान्।तैराहतो वज्रसमग्रवेगैर्न चुक्षुभे न व्यथते सुरारिः ।। ६.६७.१४० ।।
verses.transliteration: sa kumbhakarṇasya vaco niśamya rāmaḥ supuṅkhān visasarja bāṇān।tairāhato vajrasamagravegairna cukṣubhe na vyathate surāriḥ ।। 6.67.140 ।।

translations.english: Great Rama, endowed with extraordinary might, saw Kumbhakarna, the tamer of enemies covered with blood and having red eyes.

verses.sloka: यैः सायकैः सालवरा निकृत्ता वाली हतो वानरपुङ्गवश्च।ते कुम्भकर्णस्य तदा शरीरे वज्रोपमा न व्यथयाम्प्रचक्रुः ।। ६.६७.१४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: yaiḥ sāyakaiḥ sālavarā nikṛttā vālī hato vānarapuṅgavaśca।te kumbhakarṇasya tadā śarīre vajropamā na vyathayāmpracakruḥ ।। 6.67.141 ।।

translations.english: Surrounded by Rakshasas, he was searching for Vanaras, like an elephant, guarding a quarter, searches.

verses.sloka: स वारिधारा इव सायकांस्तान् पिबन् शरीरेण महेन्द्रशत्रुः।जघान रामस्य शरप्रवेगं व्याविध्य तं मुद्गरमुग्रवेगम् ।। ६.६७.१४२ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa vāridhārā iva sāyakāṁstān piban śarīreṇa mahendraśatruḥ।jaghāna rāmasya śarapravegaṁ vyāvidhya taṁ mudgaramugravegam ।। 6.67.142 ।।

translations.english: (Kumbhakarna) Adorned with gold armlets, blood flowing from his mouth was like a rain cloud showering from Vindhya or Mandara mountain.

verses.sloka: ततस्तु रक्षः क्षतजानुलिप्तं वित्रासनं देवमहाचमूनाम्।विव्याध तं मुद्गरमुग्रवेगं विद्रावयामास चमूं हरीणाम् ।। ६.६७.१४३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatastu rakṣaḥ kṣatajānuliptaṁ vitrāsanaṁ devamahācamūnām।vivyādha taṁ mudgaramugravegaṁ vidrāvayāmāsa camūṁ harīṇām ।। 6.67.143 ।।

translations.english: With blood red eyes, licking the corner of his mouth with his tongue, crushing Vanara army, he looked like God of Death at dissolution.

verses.sloka: वायव्यमादाय ततो वरास्त्रं रामः प्रचिक्षेप निशाचराय।समुद्गरं तेन जघान बाहुं स कृत्तबाहुस्तुमुलं ननाद ।। ६.६७.१४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: vāyavyamādāya tato varāstraṁ rāmaḥ pracikṣepa niśācarāya।samudgaraṁ tena jaghāna bāhuṁ sa kṛttabāhustumulaṁ nanāda ।। 6.67.144 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the foremost of Rakshasas, shining like fire, Rama, the bull among men stretched his bow.

verses.sloka: स तस्य बाहुर्गिरिशृङ्गकल्पः समुद्गरो राघवबाणकृत्तः।पपात तस्मिन् हरिराजसैन्ये जघान तां वानरवाहनीं च ।। ६.६७.१४५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tasya bāhurgiriśṛṅgakalpaḥ samudgaro rāghavabāṇakṛttaḥ।papāta tasmin harirājasainye jaghāna tāṁ vānaravāhanīṁ ca ।। 6.67.145 ।।

translations.english: Enraged by the loud sound of the twang of the bow, the bull among Rakshasas unable to bear rushed towards Raghava.

verses.sloka: ते वानरा भग्नहतावशेषाः पर्यन्तमाश्रित्य तदा विषण्णाः।प्रवेपिताङ्गं ददृशुः सुघोरं नरेन्द्ररक्षोधिपसन्निपातम् ।। ६.६७.१४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: te vānarā bhagnahatāvaśeṣāḥ paryantamāśritya tadā viṣaṇṇāḥ।pravepitāṅgaṁ dadṛśuḥ sughoraṁ narendrarakṣodhipasannipātam ।। 6.67.146 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Rama spoke to Kumbhakarna, whose hands were like Vasuki's body, coming towards him to attack on the battlefield like a cloud chased by wind.

verses.sloka: स कुम्भकर्णो ऽस्त्रनिकृत्तबाहुर्महान्निकृत्ताग्र इवाचलेन्द्रः।उत्पाटयामास करेण वृक्षं ततो ऽभिदुद्राव रणे नरेन्द्रम् ।। ६.६७.१४७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa kumbhakarṇo 'stranikṛttabāhurmahānnikṛttāgra ivācalendraḥ।utpāṭayāmāsa kareṇa vṛkṣaṁ tato 'bhidudrāva raṇe narendram ।। 6.67.147 ।।

translations.english: "O king of Rakshasas! Come. Do not be despondent. I stand with my bow. In a moment I will destroy you. Look, the Rakshasa clan will be put to an end."

verses.sloka: स तस्य बाहुं सहसालवृक्षं समुद्यतं पन्नगभोगकल्पम्।ऐन्द्रास्त्रयुक्तेन जघान रामो बाणेन जाम्बूनदचित्रितेन ।। ६.६७.१४८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tasya bāhuṁ sahasālavṛkṣaṁ samudyataṁ pannagabhogakalpam।aindrāstrayuktena jaghāna rāmo bāṇena jāmbūnadacitritena ।। 6.67.148 ।।

translations.english: Knowing that this is Rama, Kumbhakarna laughed in an unnatural manner making a sound and ran after scattering the monkeys in great rage.

verses.sloka: स कुम्भकर्णस्य भुजो निकृत्तः पपात भूमौ गिरिसन्निकाशः।विवेष्टमानो ऽभिजघान वृक्षान् शैलान् शिला वानरराक्षसांश्च ।। ६.६७.१४९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa kumbhakarṇasya bhujo nikṛttaḥ papāta bhūmau girisannikāśaḥ।viveṣṭamāno 'bhijaghāna vṛkṣān śailān śilā vānararākṣasāṁśca ।। 6.67.149 ।।

translations.english: Highly energetic Kumbhakarna laughing in hideous ways making sounds like rumblings of clouds breaking the hearts of forest rangers spoke these words.

verses.sloka: तं छिन्नबाहुं समवेक्ष्य रामः समापतन्तं सहसा नदन्तम्।द्वावर्धचन्द्रौ निशितौ प्रगृह्य चिच्छेद पादौ युधि राक्षसस्य ।। ६.६७.१५० ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ chinnabāhuṁ samavekṣya rāmaḥ samāpatantaṁ sahasā nadantam।dvāvardhacandrau niśitau pragṛhya ciccheda pādau yudhi rākṣasasya ।। 6.67.150 ।।

translations.english: "I am not Viradha, not Vijeya, not Kabhanda, not also Vali or Maricha. I am Kumbhakarna and have come."

verses.sloka: तौ तस्य पादौ प्रदिशो दिशश्च गिरीन् गुहाश्चैव महार्णवं च।लङ्कां च सेनां कपिराक्षसानां विनादयन्तौ विनिपेततुश्च ।। ६.६७.१५१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tau tasya pādau pradiśo diśaśca girīn guhāścaiva mahārṇavaṁ ca।laṅkāṁ ca senāṁ kapirākṣasānāṁ vinādayantau vinipetatuśca ।। 6.67.151 ।।

translations.english: "See my terrible club made of wrought iron. By this I have won earlier Devatas and Danavas."

verses.sloka: निकृत्तबाहुर्विनिकृत्तपादो विदार्य वक्त्रं वडवामुखाभम्।दुद्राव रामं सहसा ऽभिगर्जन् राहुर्यथा चन्द्रमिवान्तरिक्षे ।। ६.६७.१५२ ।।
verses.transliteration: nikṛttabāhurvinikṛttapādo vidārya vaktraṁ vaḍavāmukhābham।dudrāva rāmaṁ sahasā 'bhigarjan rāhuryathā candramivāntarikṣe ।। 6.67.152 ।।

translations.english: "Do not think I have been deprived of ears and nose and look with contempt. I do not have little pain."

verses.sloka: अपूरयत्तस्य मुखं शिताग्रै रामः शरैर्हेमपिनद्धपुङ्खैः।स पूर्णवक्त्रो न शशाक वक्तुं चुकूज कृच्छ्रेण मुमोह चापि ।। ६.६७.१५३ ।।
verses.transliteration: apūrayattasya mukhaṁ śitāgrai rāmaḥ śarairhemapinaddhapuṅkhaiḥ।sa pūrṇavaktro na śaśāka vaktuṁ cukūja kṛcchreṇa mumoha cāpi ।। 6.67.153 ।।

translations.english: "O Tiger of the Ikshvaku clan! Exhibit your manliness, prowess, and valour on me. I will eat you up later."

verses.sloka: अथाददे सूर्यमरीचिकल्पं स ब्रह्मदण्डान्तककालकल्पम्।अरिष्टमैन्द्रं निशितं सुपुङ्खं रामः शरं मारुततुल्यवेगम् ।। ६.६७.१५४ ।।
verses.transliteration: athādade sūryamarīcikalpaṁ sa brahmadaṇḍāntakakālakalpam।ariṣṭamaindraṁ niśitaṁ supuṅkhaṁ rāmaḥ śaraṁ mārutatulyavegam ।। 6.67.154 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Kumbhakarna's words Rama was bewildered. He discharged plumed arrows at a speed of thunderbolt. Struck by the arrows the enemy of Devatas was not shaken or agonized.

verses.sloka: तं वज्रजाम्बूनदचारुपुङ्खं प्रदीप्तसूर्यज्वलनप्रकाशम्।महेन्द्रवज्राशनितुल्यवेगं रामः प्रचिक्षेप निशाचराय ।। ६.६७.१५५ ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ vajrajāmbūnadacārupuṅkhaṁ pradīptasūryajvalanaprakāśam।mahendravajrāśanitulyavegaṁ rāmaḥ pracikṣepa niśācarāya ।। 6.67.155 ।।

translations.english: Those arrows which had cut down the Sala trees and the Vanara leader, Vali, which were like thunderbolts, did not affect Kumbhakarna's body.

verses.sloka: स सायको राघवबाहुचोदितो दिशः स्वभासा दश सम्प्रकाशयन्।सधूमवैश्वानरदीप्तदर्शनो जगाम शक्राशनिवीर्यविक्रमः ।। ६.६७.१५६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa sāyako rāghavabāhucodito diśaḥ svabhāsā daśa samprakāśayan।sadhūmavaiśvānaradīptadarśano jagāma śakrāśanivīryavikramaḥ ।। 6.67.156 ।।

translations.english: The enemy of Lord Indra drank the arrows through his body and hurled his club at great speed whirling it round and round arrested the arrows of Rama.

verses.sloka: स तन्महापर्वतकूटसन्निभं विवृत्तदंष्ट्रं चलचारुकुण्डलम्।चकर्त रक्षोधिपतेः शिरस्तथा यथैव वृत्रस्य पुरा पुरन्दरः ।। ६.६७.१५७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tanmahāparvatakūṭasannibhaṁ vivṛttadaṁṣṭraṁ calacārukuṇḍalam।cakarta rakṣodhipateḥ śirastathā yathaiva vṛtrasya purā purandaraḥ ।। 6.67.157 ।।

translations.english: Then Kumbhakarna with his club covered with blood and frightening even the celestials scattered the monkeys.

verses.sloka: कुम्भकर्णशिरो भाति कुण्डलालङ्कृतं महत्।आदित्ये ऽभ्युदिते रात्रौ मध्यस्थ इव चन्द्रमाः ।। ६.६७.१५८ ।।
verses.transliteration: kumbhakarṇaśiro bhāti kuṇḍalālaṅkṛtaṁ mahat।āditye 'bhyudite rātrau madhyastha iva candramāḥ ।। 6.67.158 ।।

translations.english: Thereupon taking up the weapon of Wind God, Rama discharged on the night ranger and severed his right arm with the mace. His arm torn off, Kumbhakarna made uproarious noise.

verses.sloka: तद्रामबाणाभिहतं पपात रक्षश्शिरःपर्वतसन्निकाशम्।बभञ्ज चर्यागृहगोपुराणि प्राकारमुच्चं तमपातयच्च ।। ६.६७.१५९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadrāmabāṇābhihataṁ papāta rakṣaśśiraḥparvatasannikāśam।babhañja caryāgṛhagopurāṇi prākāramuccaṁ tamapātayacca ।। 6.67.159 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna's arm severed by Rama's arrow was like a mountain peak. It fell on Vanara army too and killed the monkey king's army.

verses.sloka: न्यपतत् कुम्भकर्णो ऽथ स्वकायेन निपातयन्।प्लवङ्गमानां कोट्यश्च परितः सम्प्रधावताम् ।। ६.६७.१६० ।।
verses.transliteration: nyapatat kumbhakarṇo 'tha svakāyena nipātayan।plavaṅgamānāṁ koṭyaśca paritaḥ sampradhāvatām ।। 6.67.160 ।।

translations.english: Then the remaining Vanaras who escaped killing and mutilation went close feeling desperate and witnessed the comb at between Rama and Kumbhakarna.

verses.sloka: तच्चाति कायं हिमवत्प्रकाशं रक्षस्ततस्तोयनिधौ पपात।ग्राहान् वरान् मीनवरान् भुजङ्गान् ममर्द भूमिं च तदा विवेश ।। ६.६७.१६१ ।।
verses.transliteration: taccāti kāyaṁ himavatprakāśaṁ rakṣastatastoyanidhau papāta।grāhān varān mīnavarān bhujaṅgān mamarda bhūmiṁ ca tadā viveśa ।। 6.67.161 ।।

translations.english: One arm cut off, Kumbhakarna deprived of limb looked like a mountain with peak cut off. Thereafter he seized a palmyra tree and went towards Rama.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् हते ब्राह्मणदेवशत्रौ महाबले संयति कुम्भकर्णे।चचाल भूर्भूमिधराश्च सर्वे हर्षाच्च देवास्तुमुलं प्रणेदुः ।। ६.६७.१६२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmin hate brāhmaṇadevaśatrau mahābale saṁyati kumbhakarṇe।cacāla bhūrbhūmidharāśca sarve harṣācca devāstumulaṁ praṇeduḥ ।। 6.67.162 ।।

translations.english: Then Rama yoking his bow with an arrow charged with Indra's mantra and decked with gold severed Kumbhakarna's arm which was like coils of serpent and held the palmyra tree.

verses.sloka: ततस्तु देवर्षिमहर्षिपन्नगाः सुराश्च भूतानि सुपर्णगुह्यकाः।सयक्षगन्धर्वगणा नभोगताः प्रहर्षिता रामपराक्रमेण ।। ६.६७.१६३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatastu devarṣimaharṣipannagāḥ surāśca bhūtāni suparṇaguhyakāḥ।sayakṣagandharvagaṇā nabhogatāḥ praharṣitā rāmaparākrameṇa ।। 6.67.163 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna who resembled a mountain, his arm severed turning round and round fell on trees, mountains, Vanaras and Rakshasas crushing them.

verses.sloka: ततस्तु ते तस्य वधेन भूरिणा मनस्विनो नैर्ऋतराजबान्धवाः।विनेदुरुच्चैर्व्यथिता रघूत्तमं हरिं समीक्ष्यैव यथा सुरार्दिताः ।। ६.६७.१६४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatastu te tasya vadhena bhūriṇā manasvino nairṛtarājabāndhavāḥ।vineduruccairvyathitā raghūttamaṁ hariṁ samīkṣyaiva yathā surārditāḥ ।। 6.67.164 ।।

translations.english: Perceiving Kumbhakarna with broken arms rushing towards him, Rama at once took a sharp moon shaped arrow and split his feet.

verses.sloka: स देवलोकस्य तमो निहत्य सूर्यो यथा राहुमुखाद्विमुक्तः।तथा व्यभासीद्भुवि वानरौघे निहत्य रामो युधि कुम्भकर्णम् ।। ६.६७.१६५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa devalokasya tamo nihatya sūryo yathā rāhumukhādvimuktaḥ।tathā vyabhāsīdbhuvi vānaraughe nihatya rāmo yudhi kumbhakarṇam ।। 6.67.165 ।।

translations.english: Both the feet falling on ground made a resounding noise that filled all over the four quarters, all directions, nay all mountains and caves of Trikuta and also Lanka.

verses.sloka: प्रहर्षमीयुर्बहवस्तु वानराः प्रबुद्धपद्मप्रतिमैरिवाननैः।अपूजयन् राघवमिष्टभागिनं हते रिपौ भीमबले दुरासदे ।। ६.६७.१६६ ।।
verses.transliteration: praharṣamīyurbahavastu vānarāḥ prabuddhapadmapratimairivānanaiḥ।apūjayan rāghavamiṣṭabhāginaṁ hate ripau bhīmabale durāsade ।। 6.67.166 ।।

translations.english: Arms broken, feet cut off, dilating his mouth like fire, shouting aloud like Rahu entering moon in the sky he rushed to Rama speedily.

verses.sloka: स कुम्भकर्णं सुरसङ्घमर्दनं महत्सु युद्धेषु पराजितश्रमम्।ननन्द हत्वा भरताग्रजो रणे महासुरं वृत्रमिवामराधिपः ।। ६.६७.१६७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa kumbhakarṇaṁ surasaṅghamardanaṁ mahatsu yuddheṣu parājitaśramam।nananda hatvā bharatāgrajo raṇe mahāsuraṁ vṛtramivāmarādhipaḥ ।। 6.67.167 ।।

translations.english: Rama filled the mouth of Kumbhakarna with his sharp and pointed gold encrusted arrows. Unable to speak the Rakshasa moaned and fainted.

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे सप्तषष्टितमः सर्गः ।। ६७ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe saptaṣaṣṭitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 67 ।।

translations.english: Then Rama took up the effulgent sun beam like arrow with feathers and the destructive rod of Brahma and the Time spirit that was fatal to enemies that was fast as wind speed and charged with Indra's mantra.
